title: EHS Compliance Manager (m/k/n) - Grid Systems Integration Projects
description:
Job Description Summary
As EHS Governance Manager, you will be part of the EHS Organization, and your role will be to support the Regions in a global environment.

The EHS Governance Manager is responsible for defining, deploying, and maintaining an effective governance framework across Projects, Services, and Manufacturing activities within the Grid Systems Integration business line in our Electrification business segment.

The role ensures alignment with business strategy, compliance with internal policies and external regulations, risk management, and consistent execution of standards across regions and operational entities.

This position plays a key role in driving transparency, accountability, and performance while supporting operational teams in delivering safely on time, on cost, and in full compliance.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities:

- Define, implement, and continuously improve the governance model across Projects, Services, and Manufacturing, including roles, decision rights (RASCI), and escalation paths

- Ensure compliance with internal policies (EHS, Quality, Finance, Ethics, Cyber, Sustainability) and applicable local regulations

- Lead Business HQ audits for Projects & Services and Manufacturing, including subcontractors and partners; track findings through to closure

- Establish governance KPIs and dashboards; coordinate governance forums (management reviews, steering committees, gate reviews)

- Act as key interface between Business Leadership, Operations, Functions (Finance, EHS, Quality, Legal, HR), and Regions

- Coach and support leaders and operational teams on governance requirements and compliance standards

- Identify gaps and inconsistencies in governance practices; lead continuous improvement initiatives

- Support inspection programs across sites and monitor customer satisfaction surveys

- Authority to stop any activity in case of immediate danger; coordinate emergency response per Site Director direction

Required Qualifications:

- Education:   Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, Environmental Science, Safety Management, or related EHS technical discipline (accredited institution; Country EHS Accreditation required)

- Experience:   Major EHS experience in Projects, Services, Manufacturing, or Operations within an industrial or energy environment, with strong experience in governance, project management frameworks, or risk management

- Mobility:   Willingness to travel internationally up to 60%

Desired Characteristics:

- Solid understanding of matrix organizations and complex international environments

- Strong knowledge of fundamental health & safety programs (Lockout-Tagout, Confined Space, Electrical Safety, Process Safety Management)

- Familiarity with ISO 14001, ISO 45001, or similar certification standards

- Strong influencing, coaching, and stakeholder engagement skills

- Excellent oral and written communication skills across diverse audiences

- High integrity, independence, and accountability

- Additional languages (French, Spanish, German) a plus

About Our Business:
This position sits within our Grid Solutions Business's Grid Systems Integration (GSI) Business Line, in the Electrification segment of GE Vernova.
GSI delivers integrated project solutions that enable large-scale electrification and support the global energy transition — helping customers decarbonize while maintaining grid stability, reliability, and security. Our portfolio spans:

- HVDC   (High-Voltage Direct Current) — enabling efficient, long-distance power transmission with lower losses

- ACS   (Alternating Current Systems) — turnkey high-voltage substation solutions, including AIS, GIS, and digital substations

- FACTS   (Flexible AC Transmission Systems) — technologies like STATCOM and Synchronous Condensers that enhance grid flexibility and stability

- Services   — long-term service agreements, turnkey retrofits, and modernization/upgrade solutions supporting customers' assets throughout their lifecycle

Learn more about our Electrification business at   gevernova.com/electrification .

Culture & Inclusion:
At GE Vernova, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background and experiences. We are committed to fostering an  inclusive   culture , where everyone feels empowered to do their best work because they feel accepted, respected and that they belong.  Click here to learn more: Life at GE Vernova | Culture & Opportunities

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

title: Services FP&A Process Transformation Leader
description:
Job Description Summary
The Services FP&A Process Transformation Leader will own the financial strategy and performance narrative for a critical segment of our business. You will lead high-impact financial planning, analysis, and reporting, translating complex business dynamics into actionable insights that drive growth, profitability, and long-term value creation. This role requires a finance leader who moves beyond traditional reporting to actively shape the strategy, operating model, and future performance of the organization.

Job Description

- Strategic Financial Leadership: Own the financial performance narrative. Use sophisticated analysis and business drivers to assess returns on capital, assets, and overall value creation.

- Process Transformation: Shape priorities and operating programs across the functional area to drive significant improvements in quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.

- Insight-Driven Partnering: Act as a trusted thought partner to senior leadership. Influence strategic and operational decisions through sound judgment, data-driven recommendations, and clear, compelling storytelling.

- Advanced Analytics: Leverage multiple data sources and external market perspectives to challenge conventional thinking, identify root causes, and solve complex, ambiguous business problems.

- Operational Excellence: Operate with autonomy to advance financial best practices. Maintain a deep enterprise perspective to ensure alignment across diverse teams, functions, and geographies.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree from an Accredited College or University with 8+ years of professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) or Income Statement management; or High School Diploma / GED with 10+ years of relevant experience.

Desired Characteristics

- Domain Expertise: Demonstrated success in financial management within a complex, multi-layered business environment.

- Influencing & Leadership: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust, challenge status quo thinking, and drive consensus across organizational levels.

- Communication: Proven ability to synthesize complex financial concepts into simple, actionable insights for senior executives.

- Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with a track record of identifying root causes and developing innovative, data-driven solutions.

- Project Management: Demonstrated ability to lead high-impact programs from strategy through execution, balancing competing priorities and resources.

- Agility: A proactive mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping the business pivot to stay ahead of market dynamics.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Electricity Markets Required)
description:
Job Description Summary
GE Vernova is seeking a talented Software Engineer to join a skilled team of 8–15 engineers responsible for the development, enhancement, and support of our large-scale Electricity Market Management System (MMS). You will work on sophisticated software components within a mission-critical environment, collaborating with domain experts and developers to solve complex energy market challenges. This role is ideal for a professional who values technical rigor, clean code, and continuous learning.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and evolve software components and features for Wholesale Electricity Market Management (MMS) applications.

- Work independently to contribute to the immediate team's goals, while participating in design discussions and code reviews across the broader group.

- Identify task scope, provide accurate effort estimates, and deliver high-quality code within an Agile environment.

- Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve issues within MMS applications, supporting both development and production environments.

- Collaborate with the team to translate requirements into technical implementation, ensuring scalability and maintainability.

- Maintain code quality through best practices, unit testing, and automation.

- Participate in whiteboarding sessions and technical design reviews to propose and refine software solutions.

- Collaborate cross-functionally to align software deliverables with project timelines and product standards.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related STEM field.

- 3 years of professional software development experience.

- 2 years of experience working on software projects in the Energy domain (e.g., Energy Management, Power Systems, or Wholesale Electricity Markets).

Desired Characteristics

- Strong understanding of object-oriented analysis, software design patterns, and modern coding principles.

- Hands-on experience with Java (backend development) and Python (scripting/automation).

- Experience with SQL databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL).

- Familiarity with web services (REST/SOAP) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Git, Maven, Jenkins).

- Understanding of Market Management Systems (MMS) or Energy Management Systems (EMS) is highly preferred.

- Experience with containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) or cloud-native architectures is a plus.

- Familiarity with observability/logging tools (e.g., Splunk, Prometheus, ELK) is a plus.

- Ownership:  Ability to take ownership of medium-sized tasks and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision.

- Analytical Skills:  Strong problem-solving abilities; capable of breaking down complex problems and documenting clear technical approaches.

- Collaboration:  Comfortable working in a team environment; shares knowledge and seeks feedback to improve design and development.

- Adaptability:  Proactive in learning new technologies, processes, and domain-specific knowledge (Energy Markets/ISO-RTO operations).

- Communication:  Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to articulate technical ideas clearly in a collaborative setting.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Blades Fleet Engineering
description:
Job Description Summary
The Senior Data Scientist, Blade Fleet Engineering for GE Vernova, will lead proactive fleet performance management through advanced data science and machine learning. You will be responsible for driving sustained product improvement across the global fleet, shifting from reactive troubleshooting to a proactive, data-led reliability model. You will develop and implement scalable analytical initiatives and drive closed-loop lessons learned across the product lifecycle by leveraging large-scale industrial data.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities

- Predictive Analytics Integration: Leverage fleet-wide data across manufacturing, projects, and services platforms alongside AI-driven diagnostic tools to identify early-stage degradation patterns, enabling proactive maintenance strategies.

- Data-Driven RCA Methodology: Develop and deploy machine learning algorithms to process large-scale historical failure data, accelerating root cause identification and validating the efficacy of corrective actions through rigorous statistical modeling.

- Automated Quality Reporting: Implement and maintain automated data visualization dashboards and pipelines to monitor fleet quality KPIs, ensuring real-time visibility into emerging trends for leadership and stakeholders.

- Proactive Fleet Management: Collaborate with performance and reliability teams to identify and address emerging technical issues through advanced predictive modeling before they impact fleet availability.

- Data Infrastructure Ownership: Drive continuous improvements in fleet data quality, data completeness, and the underlying data architecture supporting our analytics capabilities.

- Problem-Solving Leadership: Facilitate data-driven "Kaizens" to achieve faster, more robust resolutions. Utilize statistical insights to own and support action items derived from Quality PSR (Problem Solving Report) countermeasures.

- Process Implementation: Drive the application of advanced data-centric problem-solving tools and methods throughout the root cause analysis process.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with fleet performance management, manufacturing, projects, services, and digital technology teams to ensure a unified, data-driven approach to fleet reliability. Support data initiatives driven by cross-functional teams

Qualifications & Requirements

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative STEM field.

- Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in data science, predictive analytics, or a similar high-impact technical analytical role.

Desired Characteristics

- Data Literacy & Tooling: High proficiency in data analysis and visualization software (e.g., SQL, Python, R, MATLAB, PowerBI, or Tableau) with extensive experience interpreting large, complex datasets for technical decision-making.

- AI/ML Expertise: In-depth experience in building, deploying, and monitoring production-grade machine learning models, with an understanding of how predictive maintenance applies to complex mechanical structures.

- Statistical Analysis: Strong foundation in statistical quality control (SQC), probabilistic modeling, and reliability engineering metrics (e.g., Weibull analysis, reliability growth modeling).

- Risk Mitigation: Experience developing data-driven action plans to mitigate fleet risks.

- Quality Systems: Familiarity with quality systems, procedure development, and technical execution.

- Communication: Proven ability to communicate complex analytical findings and RCA outcomes to non-technical stakeholders.

- Lean Methodologies: Experience with Lean tools, coaching, and facilitating process improvement events (e.g., Kaizen).

title: Lead Analyst, Regional Market Insights
location_raw: Cambridge; Remote; Greenville; Remote; Remote; Issy Les Moulineaux; Remote; Atlanta; Remote
description:
Job Description Summary
At GE Vernova, our mission is to electrify the world while simultaneously working to decarbonize it. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact, join a team that is helping shape the future of energy.

The Lead Analyst, Regional Market Insights will report to the Director, Generation and Electrification Forecasting within Corporate Strategy & Market Analytics. This role will serve as a key analytical partner responsible for collecting, synthesizing, and translating regional and country-level energy market intelligence into actionable business insights. The Lead Analyst will connect regional market dynamics to enterprise strategy by monitoring energy market developments, policy evolution, competitive activity, and economic drivers across core markets and priority growth countries.

Working closely with strategy, forecasting, commercial, and regional teams, this individual will develop market insights that improve prioritization, support forecasting assumptions, inform investment decisions, and help shape GE Vernova’s long-term strategic direction.

Job Description
Regional Market Intelligence

- Collect, maintain, and analyze country and regional energy market data across core and priority growth markets.

- Monitor market dynamics, demand drivers, generation trends, infrastructure needs, and investment activity.

- Support the development and maintenance of country prioritization frameworks, market attractiveness assessments, and regional opportunity views.

Policy, Regulatory, and Competitive Insights

- Analyze regional market structures, policy developments, regulatory trends, and country-specific energy transition drivers.

- Monitor competitive dynamics, market requirements, and risks that may affect GE Vernova’s growth and competitiveness.

- Identify emerging opportunities and challenges across priority regions and translate findings into concise business recommendations.

Forecasting and Strategic Planning Support

- Maintain market assumptions and input data supporting regional and country-level forecasts.

- Support the forecasting team in calibrating and validating regional and country outlooks.

- Develop quarterly regional market updates and executive-ready insights for senior leadership discussions.

Stakeholder Engagement and Market Visibility

- Apply AI-enabled research and analytics tools to improve data collection, market monitoring, and insight generation.

- Build and maintain relationships with regional teams, country councils, strategy partners, commercial teams, and business stakeholders.

- Deliver clear, data-driven recommendations that support enterprise decision-making and long-term strategic planning.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in economics, energy systems, engineering, business, data analytics, finance, or a related field, from an accredited college or university.

- Minimum of 3 years of experience working in energy markets, power markets, market analysis, energy policy, strategy, forecasting, or a related analytical discipline.

- Strong understanding of energy and power market fundamentals, market structures, policy drivers, and regional market dynamics.

- Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills, including experience working with large datasets, market research sources, and complex business information.

- Ability to translate complex market information into clear, actionable business insights for executive and cross-functional audiences.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to deliver high-quality work and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present findings and recommendations in concise, easy-to-understand terms.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint.

- Expected travel is approximately 15–20% on average.

Desired Characteristics

- Natural curiosity about global energy markets, emerging technologies, and the energy transition.

- Experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, market intelligence, power market analysis, or forecasting roles.

- Demonstrated experience with power market modeling, capacity expansion modeling, or related energy analytics tools.

- Experience using Power BI, SQL, Python, or similar tools for data analysis and visualization.

- Track record of learning and applying AI-powered tools to accelerate research, analysis, and insight generation.

- Advanced degree, including MBA, master’s degree, or PhD, in a relevant field.

- Executive presence with the ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and align teams around a common view of market opportunities and risks.

Analista Líder, Insights de Mercado Regional

Resumo da Descrição da Vaga

O Analista Líder, Insights de Mercado Regional, se reportará ao Diretor de Geração e Previsão de Eletrificação dentro da área de Estratégia Corporativa e Análise de Mercado. Esta função atuará como um parceiro analítico fundamental, responsável por coletar, sintetizar e traduzir inteligência de mercado de energia em nível regional e nacional em insights de negócios acionáveis.

Trabalhando em estreita colaboração com as equipes de estratégia, previsão, comercial e regional, este profissional desenvolverá insights de mercado que melhorem a priorização, apoiem premissas de previsão, fundamentem decisões de investimento e ajudem a moldar a direção estratégica de longo prazo da GE Vernova.

Papéis e Responsabilidades

Inteligência de Mercado Regional

- Coletar, manter e analisar dados de mercado de energia por país e região em mercados principais e de crescimento prioritário.

- Monitorar dinâmicas de mercado, fatores de demanda, tendências de geração, necessidades de infraestrutura e atividade de investimento.

- Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a manutenção de estruturas de priorização de países, avaliações de atratividade de mercado e visões de oportunidades regionais.

Políticas, Regulamentação e Insights Competitivos

- Analisar estruturas de mercado regionais, desenvolvimentos de políticas, tendências regulatórias e impulsionadores da transição energética específicos por país.

- Monitorar dinâmicas competitivas, requisitos de mercado e riscos que possam afetar o crescimento e a competitividade da GE Vernova.

- Identificar oportunidades e desafios emergentes nas regiões prioritárias e traduzir as descobertas em recomendações de negócios concisas.

Apoio à Previsão e ao Planejamento Estratégico

- Manter premissas de mercado e dados de entrada que sustentem previsões regionais e nacionais.

- Apoiar a equipe de previsão na calibração e validação de perspectivas regionais e nacionais.

- Desenvolver atualizações trimestrais de mercado regional e insights executivos para discussões com a liderança sênior.

Engajamento com Stakeholders e Visibilidade de Mercado

- Aplicar ferramentas de pesquisa e análise habilitadas por IA para melhorar a coleta de dados, o monitoramento de mercado e a geração de insights.

- Construir e manter relacionamentos com equipes regionais, conselhos nacionais, parceiros de estratégia, equipes comerciais e stakeholders do negócio.

- Entregar recomendações claras e baseadas em dados que apoiem a tomada de decisão corporativa e o planejamento estratégico de longo prazo.

Qualificações Necessárias

- Bacharelado em economia, sistemas de energia, engenharia, negócios, análise de dados, finanças ou área correlata, em uma universidade credenciada.

- Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em mercados de energia, mercados de eletricidade, análise de mercado, política energética, estratégia, previsão ou disciplina analítica relacionada.

- Sólido entendimento dos fundamentos do mercado de energia e eletricidade, estruturas de mercado, impulsionadores de políticas e dinâmica de mercado regional.

- Habilidades analíticas e quantitativas demonstradas, incluindo experiência com grandes conjuntos de dados, fontes de pesquisa de mercado e informações complexas de negócios.

- Capacidade de traduzir informações complexas de mercado em insights de negócios claros e acionáveis para públicos executivos e multifuncionais.

- Altamente organizado e orientado a detalhes, com habilidade para entregar trabalho de alta qualidade e cumprir prazos em um ambiente matricial e de ritmo acelerado.

- Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar descobertas e recomendações em termos concisos e fáceis de entender.

- Proficiência em Microsoft Excel e Microsoft PowerPoint.

- A viagem esperada é de aproximadamente 15–20% em média.

Características Desejadas

- Curiosidade natural sobre mercados globais de energia, tecnologias emergentes e transição energética.

- Experiência em consultoria estratégica, estratégia corporativa, inteligência de Eercado, análise de mercado de eletricidade ou funções de previsão.

- Experiência demonstrada com modelagem de mercado de eletricidade, modelagem de expansão de capacidade ou ferramentas de análise de energia relacionadas.

- Experiência no uso de Power BI, SQL, Python ou ferramentas similares para análise e visualização de dados.

- Histórico de aprendizado e aplicação de ferramentas baseadas em IA para acelerar a pesquisa, análise e geração de insights.

- Pós-graduação, incluindo MBA, mestrado ou doutorado, em uma área relevante.

- Presença executiva com a capacidade de construir confiança, influenciar stakeholders e alinhar equipes em torno de uma visão comum de oportunidades e riscos de mercado.

Analyste principal, Perspectives du marché régional

Résumé du poste

L’Analyste principal, Perspectives du marché régional, sera sous la responsabilité du Directeur de la génération et des prévisions d’électrification au sein du département Stratégie d’entreprise et Analyse de marché. Ce rôle servira de partenaire analytique clé, responsable de collecter, synthétiser et traduire l’intelligence du marché de l’énergie à l’échelle régionale et nationale en perspectives commerciales exploitables.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de stratégie, de prévision, commerciales et régionales, cette personne développera des perspectives de marché qui amélioreront la hiérarchisation des priorités, soutiendront les hypothèses de prévision, éclaireront les décisions d’investissement et contribueront à définir l’orientation stratégique à long terme de GE Vernova.

Rôles et responsabilités

Intelligence du marché régional

- Collecter, maintenir et analyser les données du marché de l’énergie pour les pays et les régions au sein des marchés principaux et prioritaires.

- Surveiller la dynamique du marché, les moteurs de la demande, les tendances en matière de production, les besoins en infrastructure et l’activité d’investissement.

- Soutenir le développement et la maintenance des cadres de priorisation des pays, les évaluations de l’attractivité des marchés et les vues d’opportunités régionales.

Politiques, réglementation et perspectives concurrentielles

- Analyser les structures des marchés régionaux, les développements politiques, les tendances réglementaires et les facteurs de transition énergétique spécifiques à chaque pays.

- Surveiller la dynamique concurrentielle, les exigences du marché et les risques pouvant affecter la croissance et la compétitivité de GE Vernova.

- Identifier les opportunités et les défis émergents dans les régions prioritaires et traduire les résultats en recommandations commerciales concises.

Soutien à la prévision et à la planification stratégique

- Maintenir les hypothèses de marché et les données d’entrée soutenant les prévisions au niveau régional et national.

- Soutenir l’équipe de prévision dans le calibrage et la validation des perspectives régionales et nationales.

- Développer des mises à jour trimestrielles du marché régional et des perspectives destinées aux discussions de la haute direction.

Engagement des parties prenantes et visibilité du marché

- Appliquer des outils de recherche et d’analyse basés sur l’IA pour améliorer la collecte de données, la surveillance du marché et la génération de perspectives.

- Établir et entretenir des relations avec les équipes régionales, les conseils nationaux, les partenaires stratégiques, les équipes commerciales et les parties prenantes de l’entreprise.

- Fournir des recommandations claires et basées sur des données qui soutiennent la prise de décision en entreprise et la planification stratégique à long terme.

Qualifications requises

- Licence en économie, systèmes énergétiques, ingénierie, commerce, analyse de données, finance ou domaine connexe, obtenue dans une université accréditée.

- Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience dans les marchés de l’énergie, les marchés de l’électricité, l’analyse de marché, la politique énergétique, la stratégie, la prévision ou une discipline analytique connexe.

- Compréhension solide des fondamentaux des marchés de l’énergie et de l’électricité, des structures de marché, des moteurs politiques et de la dynamique des marchés régionaux.

- Compétences analytiques et quantitatives démontrées, incluant une expérience avec de grands ensembles de données, des sources de recherche de marché et des informations commerciales complexes.

- Capacité à traduire des informations de marché complexes en perspectives commerciales claires et exploitables pour des publics exécutifs et interfonctionnels.

- Très organisé et soucieux du détail, avec la capacité de fournir un travail de haute qualité et de respecter les délais dans un environnement matriciel et dynamique.

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de présenter des résultats et des recommandations de manière concise et compréhensible.

- Maîtrise de Microsoft Excel et Microsoft PowerPoint.

- Déplacements prévus d’environ 15 à 20 % en moyenne.

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Curiosité naturelle pour les marchés mondiaux de l’énergie, les technologies émergentes et la transition énergétique.

- Expérience en conseil en stratégie, stratégie d’entreprise, veille économique, analyse des marchés de l’électricité ou rôles de prévision.

- Expérience démontrée en modélisation des marchés de l’électricité, modélisation de l’expansion des capacités ou outils d’analyse énergétique connexes.

title: Lead Analyst, Energy Forecasting & Advanced Analytics
location_raw: Cambridge; Remote; Remote; Greenville; Remote; Atlanta; Remote
description:
Job Description Summary
GE Vernova is modernizing its forecasting capabilities to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and strategic value of its power system outlooks. The Lead Analyst, Energy Forecasting & Advanced Analytics will help build GE Vernova’s next-generation forecasting platform by contributing to model development, data engineering, automation, advanced analytics, and operational execution. This hands-on technical role will help translate strategy into scalable, production-ready forecasting capabilities while supporting the adoption of modern analytics and AI-enabled workflows across the forecasting function.

Job Description
Model Development and Execution

- Build and maintain components of capacity expansion models, production cost and dispatch models, and scenario and sensitivity analysis frameworks.

- Translate business and domain inputs into structured, testable model logic.

Data Engineering and Pipeline Development

- Develop and maintain data pipelines for internal and external datasets.

- Clean, transform, and validate large datasets for modeling use.

- Support data governance practices and standardized modeling inputs.

Advanced Analytics and Programming

- Develop analytical tools in Python, R, Julia, or similar languages to modernize spreadsheet-based workflows.

- Implement automation for recurring forecasting processes.

- Contribute to reusable code, libraries, and analytics modules that improve scalability and consistency.

AI-Enabled Analytics

- Apply AI tools to support data extraction and processing from structured and unstructured sources.

- Use AI-enabled approaches to summarize market reports and datasets and enhance modeling inputs.

- Support experimentation with emerging AI methods across forecasting workflows.

Operational Support and Continuous Improvement

- Execute forecasting runs and calibrate, validate, and interpret model outputs.

- Identify and resolve model, data, and workflow issues.

- Improve the performance, scalability, and usability of forecasting models over time.

Collaboration and Insight Development

- Partner with domain experts to understand assumptions, market logic, and forecasting requirements.

- Contribute to analysis of market trends and model outputs.

- Help prepare clear insights and decision-support materials for internal stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, data science, economics, or a related field from an accredited university or college.

- 3–5 years of experience in energy analytics, forecasting, power markets, advanced analytics, data science, or a related technical field with strong interest in energy.

- Strong proficiency with modern analytical tools and programming languages such as Python, R, Julia, or similar.

- Experience working with large datasets and analytical workflows.

- Demonstrated experience applying AI, advanced analytics, data science, or quantitative methods in market analysis, forecasting, or decision support.

Desired Characteristics

- Experience with energy system models, including capacity expansion, production cost, dispatch, power system optimization, or related models.

- Experience with data tools such as SQL, cloud platforms, APIs, Power BI, Python, or similar tools.

- Familiarity with power markets, generation technologies, and energy policy.

- Exposure to AI, machine learning, or generative AI tools in analytics workflows.

- Experience transitioning analytical workflows from Excel into scalable modeling environments.

- Ability to partner effectively with domain experts and translate between technical, economic, and business perspectives.

- Experience building or modernizing analytics capabilities in an enterprise environment.

- Strong curiosity, continuous learning mindset, attention to detail, and ability to organize and prioritize multiple projects with urgency.

- Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to distill complex issues into clear, simple messages.

- Advanced degree such as an MBA, master’s degree, or PhD in a relevant field.

Resumo da Descrição do Cargo

A GE Vernova está modernizando suas capacidades de previsão para melhorar a precisão, a eficiência e o valor estratégico de suas perspectivas sobre sistemas de energia. A pessoa Analista Líder, Previsão de Energia e Análises Avançadas ajudará a construir a plataforma de previsão de próxima geração da GE Vernova, contribuindo para desenvolvimento de modelos, engenharia de dados, automação, análises avançadas e execução operacional. Esta função técnica e prática ajudará a transformar a estratégia em capacidades de previsão escaláveis e prontas para produção, ao mesmo tempo em que apoiará a adoção de análises modernas e fluxos de trabalho habilitados por IA na área de previsão.

Funções e Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Execução de Modelos

- Criar e manter componentes de modelos de expansão de capacidade, modelos de custo de produção e despacho, além de estruturas de análise de cenários e sensibilidades.

- Traduzir informações de negócios e domínio em lógica de modelo estruturada e testável.

Engenharia de Dados e Desenvolvimento de Pipelines

- Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados para conjuntos de dados internos e externos.

- Limpar, transformar e validar grandes conjuntos de dados para uso em modelagem.

- Apoiar práticas de governança de dados e entradas padronizadas para modelagem.

Análises Avançadas e Programação

- Desenvolver ferramentas analíticas em Python, R, Julia ou linguagens similares para modernizar fluxos de trabalho baseados em planilhas.

- Implementar automação para processos recorrentes de previsão.

- Contribuir para código reutilizável, bibliotecas e módulos analíticos que melhorem a escalabilidade e a consistência.

Análises Habilitadas por IA

- Aplicar ferramentas de IA para apoiar a extração e o processamento de dados de fontes estruturadas e não estruturadas.

- Usar abordagens habilitadas por IA para resumir relatórios de mercado e conjuntos de dados e aprimorar entradas de modelagem.

- Apoiar experimentações com métodos emergentes de IA em fluxos de trabalho de previsão.

Suporte Operacional e Melhoria Contínua

- Executar rodadas de previsão e calibrar, validar e interpretar resultados de modelos.

- Identificar e resolver problemas de modelo, dados e fluxo de trabalho.

- Melhorar continuamente o desempenho, a escalabilidade e a usabilidade dos modelos de previsão.

Colaboração e Desenvolvimento de Insights

- Atuar em parceria com especialistas de domínio para compreender premissas, lógica de mercado e requisitos de previsão.

- Contribuir para a análise de tendências de mercado e resultados de modelos.

- Ajudar a preparar insights claros e materiais de apoio à decisão para stakeholders internos.

Qualificações Necessárias

- Bacharelado em engenharia, ciência de dados, economia ou área relacionada por universidade ou faculdade acreditada.

- 3 a 5 anos de experiência em análises de energia, previsão, mercados de energia, análises avançadas, ciência de dados ou área técnica relacionada, com forte interesse em energia.

- Proficiência sólida em ferramentas analíticas modernas e linguagens de programação, como Python, R, Julia ou similares.

- Experiência trabalhando com grandes conjuntos de dados e fluxos de trabalho analíticos.

- Experiência comprovada na aplicação de IA, análises avançadas, ciência de dados ou métodos quantitativos em análise de mercado, previsão ou apoio à decisão.

- Experiência com modelos de sistemas de energia, incluindo expansão de capacidade, custo de produção, despacho, otimização de sistemas de energia ou modelos relacionados.

- Experiência com ferramentas de dados, como SQL, plataformas em nuvem, APIs, Power BI, Python ou ferramentas similares.

Résumé de la description du poste

GE Vernova modernise ses capacités de prévision afin d’améliorer la précision, l’efficacité et la valeur stratégique de ses perspectives sur les systèmes électriques. L’Analyste principal, Prévision énergétique et analyses avancées contribuera à bâtir la plateforme de prévision de prochaine génération de GE Vernova en travaillant au développement de modèles, à l’ingénierie des données, à l’automatisation, aux analyses avancées et à l’exécution opérationnelle. Ce rôle technique et concret aidera à transformer la stratégie en capacités de prévision évolutives et prêtes pour la production, tout en soutenant l’adoption d’analyses modernes et de flux de travail habilités par l’IA dans la fonction de prévision.

Rôles et responsabilités

Développement et exécution de modèles

- Créer et maintenir des composantes de modèles d’expansion de capacité, de modèles de coûts de production et de dispatching, ainsi que des cadres d’analyse de scénarios et de sensibilités.

- Traduire les intrants métier et les connaissances de domaine en logique de modèle structurée et testable.

Ingénierie des données et développement de pipelines

Analyses avancées et programmation

Analyses habilitées par l’IA

- Utiliser des approches habilitées par l’IA pour résumer des rapports de marché et des ensembles de données, et améliorer les intrants de modélisation.

- Soutenir l’expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes d’IA dans les flux de travail de prévision.

Soutien opérationnel et amélioration continue

- Identifier et résoudre les problèmes liés aux modèles, aux données et aux flux de travail.

Collaboration et développement d’insights

- Contribuer à l’analyse des tendances du marché et des résultats des modèles.

Qualifications requises

- Baccalauréat en génie, science des données, économie ou domaine connexe délivré par une université ou un établissement accrédité.

- Expérience du travail avec de grands ensembles de données et des flux de travail analytiques.

- Expérience démontrée dans l’application de l’IA, des analyses avancées, de la science des données ou de méthodes quantitatives à l’analyse de marché, à la prévision ou à l’aide à la décision.

title: Lead Systems/Data Architect - Power Product Management Strategist
description:
Job Description Summary
This role will be a key leadership role within the product management function and a critical part of the broader Gas Power cost imperative.  The Lead Systems/Data Architect within product management will translate functional requirements and constrains from Stakeholders (Customers, Supply Chain, Partners, etc.) coupled with big data analytics to drive both product design and operational improvements.  The ideal team member will have the mathematical and statistical expertise with a natural curiosity and creative mind geared towards problem solving. The Architect will mine, interpret, clean, and synthesize data (across technical, operational, and financial domains) from which to ask questions, connect the dots, and uncover opportunities that lie hidden within—all with the ultimate goal of realizing the data’s full potential to influence the way we operate and serve our customers. They will drive configurability across the plant/product modules for cost effective business decisions optimizing the total value of our solutions while meeting market/customer needs. They will influence, collaborate, and work closely with the horizontal functional partners to achieve the optimal and effective decisions.

Job Description

Key Deliverables:

- Work as the lead data strategist, identifying, integrating, sorting, and placing the data infrastructure (e.g. parts ordering, customer need by dates, and logistics cycle times) needed for our product capabilities and competitiveness. This involves cross functional collaboration (e.g. information technology, sourcing, engineering, etc… teams) and strategy setting aimed at providing tactical process changes in the measurement methods and accuracy used to improve our performance against safety, quality, on time delivery, and cost.

- Analyze historical and incoming data for trends and patterns (e.g. mean and standard deviation cost/part, part/supplier lead time fluctuations, cost of poor quality, transport equipment utilization rates, etc.…), and interpret data with clear output signals to the respective function to take action and create new cost out opportunities.

title: Lead Project Manager – Grid Services & Closeout
description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description
GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World
With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.
Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

Let’s Talk about the Role
As a Lead Project Manager, you will manage the post-commissioning lifecycle and long-term service portfolio for Grid Systems Integration (GSI) infrastructure. You will oversee project closeout activities and the delivery of Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSA), spare parts, and maintenance support, ensuring customer satisfaction, financial performance, and timely service delivery. Working with autonomy, you will coordinate cross-functional teams and ensure projects and service activities are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard.

Key Responsibilities

- Project Closeout: Lead the final stages of GSI projects, including HVDC, FACTS, and EPC turnkey sites. Drive punch-list resolution, final documentation, customer acceptance, and project handover.

- Services Lifecycle Management: Manage LTSA delivery, including preventive maintenance, field service interventions, technical support, and ongoing customer requirements.

- Financial & Contract Management: Manage service contract and closeout financials, including Budget 0 analysis, revenue recognition, invoicing, cost control, contract variations, and claims. Maintain a strong understanding of contractual technical and commercial requirements.

- Spare Parts & Logistics: Coordinate the end-to-end spare parts process, including demand planning, procurement, delivery, and customer inventory management.

- Customer & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary customer interface post-handover, building long-term relationships, managing expectations, and identifying opportunities for service expansion. Work closely with the GSI team to ensure accurate contract and budget analysis.

- Resource Coordination: Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including field service engineers, logistics, and technical specialists, to deliver service activities safely and efficiently.

- EHS, Quality & Continuous Improvement: Ensure compliance with GE Vernova’s EHS, quality, and integrity standards. Promote lessons learned and continuous improvement across service and project delivery activities, with the authority to stop work where significant safety or quality risks are identified.

What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications)

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or an equivalent technical/business field.

- Experience managing service contracts, project closeouts, or technical service operations, preferably within the energy sector.

- Customer-facing experience with strong stakeholder management and conflict-resolution skills.

- Ability to manage SLAs, multiple workstreams, and deliver results under pressure.

- Excellent English communication skills and willingness to travel as required.

What will make you stand out

- Project management certification (e.g., PMP/PMI or equivalent).

- Knowledge of HV infrastructure, particularly HVDC, FACTS, and EPC turnkey power systems.

- Experience in Services and Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSA).

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to process improvement.

- Experience in international, multicultural environments; additional languages are a plus.

Our Culture
Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!

We're determined to be the best place to grow
We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.

We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.

Inclusion & Diversity
We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.

Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

title: Estagio em FP&A
description:
Job Description Summary
Sobre a GE Vernova: A GE Vernova é uma empresa global comprometida em fornecer tecnologias e soluções inovadoras para a geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia. Nosso objetivo é capacitar um futuro energético mais limpo, seguro e eficiente para todos.

Sobre a Unidade de Negócio Power Conversion: Nosso objetivo é oferecer tecnologias eficientes e confiáveis para a geração de energia a partir de fontes térmicas, como gás natural, carvão e biomassa. Através de inovações em design e engenharia, buscamos melhorar a eficiência energética, reduzir emissões e fornecer soluções integradas para a gestão de energia. A unidade também oferece serviços de manutenção, reparo e operação para garantir a máxima disponibilidade e desempenho dos equipamentos. description:
Job Description Summary
GE Vernova Grid Automation bietet Kunden ein umfassendes Portfolio an innovativen Produkten, Systemen und Dienstleistungen von Design und Fertigung bis hin zu Inbetriebnahme und langfristiger Wartung von Schutz- und Automatisierungslösungen für Umspannwerke.

Als Technical Application Engineer (TAE) unterstützt du das Commercial Team und übernimmst die technische Federführung für zugewiesene Ausschreibungen. Du koordinierst und steuerst alle kommerziellen und technischen Aktivitäten im Bereich Grid Automation für die jeweilige Region.

Du wirst Teil eines regionalen TAE- & KAM (Key Account Management)-Teams sein, das die Commercial Teams in allen technischen Belangen rund um Grid Automation in den Regionen Deutschland, Österreich und Schweiz (DACH) unterstützt.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities

- Du berätst interne und externe Kunden zum gesamten Grid Automation Portfolio mit Schwerpunkt auf Digital Control Systems (DCS), Cybersicherheit, Patch-Management und IED (Intelligent Electronic Device)-Asset-Management, sowohl telefonisch als auch vor Ort.

- Du repräsentierst GE Vernova als verlässlicher Technologie- und Geschäftspartner gegenüber unseren Kunden.

- Du analysierst und löst Kundenanfragen eigenständig, unter Anwendung fundierter ingenieurwissenschaftlicher Methoden sowie unter Einhaltung geltender Geschäftsstandards, Prozesse und Terminvorgaben.

- Du unterstützt die Commercial- und Sales-Organisation bei der Entwicklung technischer Lösungen, bei Produktpräsentationen, technischen Verhandlungen und der Erstellung formeller Angebote für Grid Automation Produkte und Lösungen gemäß Kundenspezifikationen.

- Du übernimmst die technische Federführung für zugewiesene Ausschreibungen von der Lösungsarchitektur bis zur vollständigen Konformitätsprüfung mit Kundenanforderungen und treibst die Erstellung wettbewerbsfähiger, anforderungskonformer Angebote über den gesamten Bieterprozess hinweg voran.

- Du nimmst bei Bedarf an Fachmessen, Seminaren und Konferenzen teil.

Desired Characteristics

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektro- oder Elektroniktechnik, Energietechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung — alternativ eine abgeschlossene Weiterbildung als Techniker oder Meister in der Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzschutz und/oder Leittechniksystemen (Substation Control Systems) im Bereich Übertragungs- und Verteilnetze

- Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Cybersicherheit sowie im Softwareumfeld (DCS (Distributed Control System) / SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) / Remote Access)

- Arbeitskenntnisse in Netzschutz, Stationsautomatisierung und Fernwirktechnik (RTUs (Remote Terminal Units)) zur Unterstützung von Kunden bei der Auswahl und Implementierung geeigneter Lösungen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Reisebereitschaft für nationale und internationale Einsätze

- Ideallerweise Erfahrung mit IEC 61850-basierten Automatisierungslösungen für Umspannwerke

- Erfahrung mit Netzwerkprotokollen, HMI (Human Machine Interface)-Systemen und einschlägigen Softwarepaketen

Job Description Summary
The Contracts Manager role is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) position providing contract leadership and expertise for commercial and government project teams across the Power Conversion and Storage portfolio. In this role, the Contract Manager will also provide oversight of program property management needs and be the focal point within the Government projects organization for contract specific tasks such as the lead support of contract property disposition and closeout, and the interpretation and negotiation of contract level terms and issues, as well as involvement in long term strategy and planning.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities:

- Support proposal activities, including but not limited to: analysis of the Request for Proposals, ensuring proper contract reviews and relevant compliance matrices are completed before any proposals are submitted to customer or any execution activities begin, with particular attention to the financial and business risks of the proposed effort, participating in all proposal team meeting, preparing terms, conditions and assumptions upon which the proposal may be submitted

- Provide support and guidance to project teams during contract execution to ensure full compliance with contract terms and relevant government regulations

- Offer innovative approaches to problem solving and develop solutions to contracting issues in supporting all phases of the acquisition cycle

- Support sourcing with preparation of flow-down packages for sub-contractors/suppliers and managing sub-contractors/suppliers during contract execution

- Ensure that proper FAR, DFARS, DEARS, and other commercial and government flow-down requirements are complied with in subcontracts and contracts

- Establish records for government property by maintaining the property tracking system

- Perform regular audits of the property management system in accordance with company procedures and government regulations.

- Coordinate the physical inventory of property and reconcile results to ensure compliance with FAR 52.245 (and other applicable regulations)

- Provide periodic accountability reports to internal and external customers as required to support contractual requirements (e.g., DD 1662)

- Coordinate disposition of property identified by contractual requirements in accordance with procedures

- Facilitate and coordinate DCAA/DCMA audits with respect to the property management system. Champion all corrective actions in response to findings

- Bachelor’s Degree with minimum of 6 years of experience in government and commercial contract formation and execution

- Experience with various contract types (i.e. Firm Fixed Price (FFP), Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) and contract change management

- Experience administering or executing a FAR 52.245 compliant government property management system

- Proven ability to draft and negotiate contractual language

- Professional certification by the NCMA, NPMA, US government contracts

Desired Characteristics:

- Power industry contracting experience interfacing directly with commercial and government customers or prime contractors

- Extensive knowledge of contract formation and regulations

- Proficiency with Excel, Power Point, and Word

- Self-starter with the ability to work independently and cohesively with teams

- Solid oral and written communication skills

- Anticipates, identifies, and resolves complex contractual issues

- Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, with ability to build solid relationships with others in the pricing team, cost contributors, and management

- High-energy team player

- Ability to manage projects / assignments within tight deadlines

title: Manager, Energy Market Research & Power Economics
location_raw: Cambridge; Remote; Greenville; Remote; Remote; Remote; Atlanta; Remote
description:
Job Description Summary
Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority, and GE Vernova takes its responsibility seriously. Our mission is to continue electrifying the world while working to help decarbonize it. Together, we have the energy to change the world.

The Manager, Energy Market Research & Power Economics will report to the Executive Director of Market Analytics & Business Intelligence within the Corporate Strategy & Market Analytics organization. In this role, you will provide enterprise-level market intelligence, power economics analysis, and strategic insight to inform GE Vernova’s long-term strategy, investment priorities, and market positioning. You will partner with corporate and business unit leaders to identify emerging market opportunities, assess risks, and translate complex energy market dynamics into clear, actionable recommendations.

Job Description
Your Role

- Lead analysis of global and regional energy market trends, including the strategic implications of market shifts, technology adoption, policy changes, and evolving customer needs.

- Develop and maintain enterprise market intelligence and GE Vernova’s House View to support strategic planning, portfolio decisions, and business growth priorities.

- Assess long-term energy demand and supply trends, electrification growth drivers, energy security considerations, and power system resilience needs.

- Partner with forecasting teams to align market assumptions, scenarios, and outlooks across regions and business units.

- Analyze power market dynamics, electricity pricing trends, and the techno-economic competitiveness of generation, grid, and storage technologies.

- Evaluate the impact of policy, regulation, market design, and investment signals on energy infrastructure decisions and technology adoption.

- Assess market opportunities and potential disruption from emerging technologies, business models, and strategic adjacencies in collaboration with Strategy, Ventures, and Advanced Research teams.

- Prepare executive-ready insights, recommendations, and presentations that clearly communicate market implications and strategic choices to senior stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, finance, economics, business, or a related field, from an accredited college or university.

- Minimum of 8 years of experience in energy markets, power markets, corporate strategy, market analytics, strategic planning, growth strategy, or a related field.

- Strong understanding of energy and power market fundamentals, fuel markets, energy policy, market design, and techno-economic analysis.

- Experience conducting energy market research and translating data-driven analysis into strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to solve complex business problems, develop analytical frameworks, synthesize conclusions, and communicate recommendations clearly.

- Ability and willingness to travel approximately 15–20%, as business needs require.

Desired Qualifications

- Experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, market analytics, or energy-sector advisory roles.

- Demonstrated experience with power market modeling, capacity expansion modeling, production cost modeling, or related analytical tools.

- Experience using Python or similar tools for data analysis, automation, modeling, or visualization.

- Advanced degree, such as an MBA, master’s degree, or PhD, in a relevant field.

- Track record of using AI-powered or advanced analytics tools to accelerate strategic analysis and improve decision quality.

- Executive presence, strong commercial intuition, and the ability to influence across a matrixed, global organization.

Additional Information
This role may be posted in Brazil, Hungary, and Canada. Employment terms, benefits, pay transparency requirements, and posting language may vary by country and will be managed in accordance with applicable local law and GE Vernova policy. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Gerente de Pesquisa de Mercado de Energia e Economia de Energia

Enfrentar a crise climática é uma prioridade global urgente, e a GE Vernova leva essa responsabilidade a sério. Nossa missão é continuar eletrificando o mundo enquanto trabalhamos para ajudar a descarbonizá-lo. Juntos, temos a energia para mudar o mundo.

O(a) Gerente de Pesquisa de Mercado de Energia e Economia de Energia se reportará ao Diretor Executivo de Market Analytics & Business Intelligence, dentro da organização de Corporate Strategy & Market Analytics. Nesta função, você fornecerá inteligência de mercado em nível empresarial, análises de economia do setor elétrico e insights estratégicos para apoiar a estratégia de longo prazo, as prioridades de investimento e o posicionamento de mercado da GE Vernova. Você trabalhará em parceria com líderes corporativos e das unidades de negócios para identificar oportunidades emergentes, avaliar riscos e traduzir dinâmicas complexas do mercado de energia em recomendações claras e acionáveis.

Sua função

- Liderar análises de tendências globais e regionais do mercado de energia, incluindo implicações estratégicas de mudanças de mercado, adoção de tecnologias, alterações regulatórias e evolução das necessidades dos clientes.

- Desenvolver e manter inteligência de mercado empresarial e a House View da GE Vernova para apoiar o planejamento estratégico, decisões de portfólio e prioridades de crescimento.

- Avaliar tendências de longo prazo de oferta e demanda de energia, drivers de crescimento da eletrificação, segurança energética e necessidades de resiliência dos sistemas elétricos.

- Trabalhar com equipes de previsão para alinhar premissas de mercado, cenários e perspectivas entre regiões e unidades de negócios.

- Analisar dinâmicas dos mercados de energia elétrica, tendências de preços de eletricidade e a competitividade técnico-econômica de tecnologias de geração, rede e armazenamento.

- Avaliar o impacto de políticas públicas, regulação, desenho de mercado e sinais de investimento nas decisões de infraestrutura energética e adoção de tecnologias.

- Avaliar oportunidades de mercado e potenciais disrupções decorrentes de tecnologias emergentes, modelos de negócios e adjacências estratégicas em colaboração com as equipes de Estratégia, Ventures e Pesquisa Avançada.

- Preparar insights, recomendações e apresentações para executivos, comunicando claramente implicações de mercado e escolhas estratégicas para stakeholders seniores.

Qualificações básicas

- Bacharelado em engenharia, ciências, finanças, economia, administração ou área relacionada, obtido em faculdade ou universidade credenciada.

- Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência em mercados de energia, mercados de energia elétrica, estratégia corporativa, análise de mercado, planejamento estratégico, estratégia de crescimento ou área relacionada.

- Forte compreensão dos fundamentos dos mercados de energia e energia elétrica, mercados de combustíveis, política energética, desenho de mercado e análise técnico-econômica.

- Experiência na condução de pesquisas de mercado de energia e na tradução de análises orientadas por dados em recomendações estratégicas para stakeholders seniores.

- Capacidade comprovada de resolver problemas de negócios complexos, desenvolver estruturas analíticas, sintetizar conclusões e comunicar recomendações com clareza.

- Disponibilidade para viajar aproximadamente 15–20%, conforme as necessidades do negócio.

Qualificações desejadas

- Experiência em consultoria estratégica, estratégia corporativa, análise de mercado ou funções de consultoria no setor de energia.

- Experiência comprovada com modelagem de mercados de energia elétrica, modelagem de expansão de capacidade, modelagem de custos de produção ou ferramentas analíticas relacionadas.

- Experiência com Python ou ferramentas semelhantes para análise de dados, automação, modelagem ou visualização.

- Pós-graduação, como MBA, mestrado ou doutorado, em área relevante.

- Histórico de uso de ferramentas baseadas em IA ou análises avançadas para acelerar análises estratégicas e melhorar a qualidade das decisões.

- Presença executiva, forte intuição comercial e capacidade de influenciar em uma organização global e matricial.

Gestionnaire, recherche sur les marchés de l’énergie et économie de l’électricité

Répondre à la crise climatique est une priorité mondiale urgente, et GE Vernova prend cette responsabilité très au sérieux. Notre mission consiste à continuer d’électrifier le monde tout en contribuant à sa décarbonation. Ensemble, nous avons l’énergie nécessaire pour changer le monde.

Le ou la gestionnaire, recherche sur les marchés de l’énergie et économie de l’électricité, relèvera du directeur exécutif, Market Analytics & Business Intelligence, au sein de l’organisation Corporate Strategy & Market Analytics. Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez une veille de marché à l’échelle de l’entreprise, des analyses économiques des marchés de l’électricité et des perspectives stratégiques afin d’éclairer la stratégie à long terme, les priorités d’investissement et le positionnement de marché de GE Vernova. Vous collaborerez avec les dirigeants des fonctions corporatives et des unités d’affaires afin d’identifier les occasions émergentes, d’évaluer les risques et de traduire des dynamiques complexes du marché de l’énergie en recommandations claires et exploitables.

Votre rôle

- Diriger l’analyse des tendances mondiales et régionales des marchés de l’énergie, y compris les implications stratégiques des évolutions du marché, de l’adoption des technologies, des changements de politiques et de l’évolution des besoins des clients.

- Développer et maintenir la veille de marché de l’entreprise ainsi que la House View de GE Vernova afin d’appuyer la planification stratégique, les décisions de portefeuille et les priorités de croissance.

- Évaluer les tendances à long terme de l’offre et de la demande d’énergie, les moteurs de croissance de l’électrification, les considérations liées à la sécurité énergétique et les besoins de résilience des systèmes électriques.

- Collaborer avec les équipes de prévision afin d’harmoniser les hypothèses de marché, les scénarios et les perspectives entre les régions et les unités d’affaires.

- Analyser les dynamiques des marchés de l’électricité, les tendances des prix de l’électricité ainsi que la compétitivité technico-économique des technologies de production, de réseau et de stockage.

- Évaluer l’incidence des politiques, de la réglementation, de la conception des marchés et des signaux d’investissement sur les décisions liées aux infrastructures énergétiques et à l’adoption des technologies.

- Évaluer les occasions de marché et les perturbations potentielles liées aux technologies émergentes, aux modèles d’affaires et aux adjacences stratégiques, en collaboration avec les équipes Stratégie, Ventures et Recherche avancée.

- Préparer des analyses, recommandations et présentations destinées aux dirigeants, en communiquant clairement les implications du marché et les choix stratégiques aux parties prenantes de haut niveau.

Qualifications de base

- Baccalauréat en ingénierie, sciences, finances, économie, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe, obtenu auprès d’un collège ou d’une université accrédité.

- Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans les marchés de l’énergie, les marchés de l’électricité, la stratégie d’entreprise, l’analyse de marché, la planification stratégique, la stratégie de croissance ou un domaine connexe.

- Solide compréhension des fondamentaux des marchés de l’énergie et de l’électricité, des marchés des combustibles, des politiques énergétiques, de la conception des marchés et de l’analyse technico-économique.

title: Principal AI Data Architect
description:
Job Description Summary
As a Principal AI Data Architect, you will define and evolve the enterprise data architecture needed to deliver trusted, scalable, secure, and cost-efficient AI products. This work starts with data. You will design systems that connect diverse data sources to AI agents and ensure the information is clean, accessible, and ready for advanced analytics. You will also shape the technical data engineering strategy, set clear architectural standards, and translate complex business priorities into robust, production-ready capabilities.

You’ll partner with product managers, AI engineers, and security teams to ensure data governance, security protocols and compliance rules are enforced when Agents need access to data sources. Expect to drive strategy, provide leadership in data engineering, clarify outcomes, and shape standards. If you’re unsure, apply.

Job Description
RESPONSIBILITIES

- Enable AI and GenAI use cases: Ensure data is usable for LLM and ML applications, such as RAG, vector-based knowledge retrieval, agentic workflows, AI-assisted reporting, or secure data access for agents

- Establish data trust, security, and responsible-AI controls including data quality and validation, lineage, metadata, privacy, RBAC/ABAC, auditability, retention, policy enforcement, and AI-output evaluation and monitoring.

- Drive technology, platform, and investment decisions by evaluating cloud data services, AI platforms, frameworks, and vendors; lead build-versus-buy assessments with explicit consideration of performance, resilience, security, operability, and total cost of ownership.

- Define the target-state AI data architecture and multi-year roadmap for data ingestion, integration, storage, modeling, semantic access, and AI consumption; establish reusable reference architectures and engineering standards across domains.

- Provide principal-level technical leadership across the organization by leading architecture reviews, resolving complex cross-domain design issues, partnering with product, engineering, security, and executive leaders

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Data Science or Information Systems or related field

- 10+ years of experience as a Data Architect, Data Engineer, ML Ops or similar role with enterprise data systems

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical decisions and influence senior stakeholders, with strong communication skills and experience establishing data governance, security, privacy, quality, lineage, and operational standards in enterprise or regulated environments.

- Demonstrated experience delivering data foundations for AI/ML or GenAI solutions, including one or more of RAG, vector databases, enterprise search, LLM evaluation, agentic workflows, feature/data pipelines, and model-serving integration

- Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in data processing libraries

- Hands on experience with MCP Servers and MCP Registries.

Eligibility:

- Must be willing to work out of an office located in Niskayuna, NY or Cambridge, MA.

- Accelerated Immersion for Senior talent: Impact starts with a deep understanding of our core capabilities. For Cambridge, MA based resources, this position includes a required three-month (hybrid) onboarding residency at the GE Vernova Advanced Research Center in Niskayuna, NY. This immersive program allows our senior talent to establish a strong technical foundation, collaborate with our premier scientists and engineers, and align with our mission to lead the energy transition from the epicenter of our innovation hub. Travel, housing, and living stipend provided.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience developing on AWS Bedrock

- Deep hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python, plus practical experience with data-processing and orchestration technologies such as Databricks, RedShift, Snowflake, Kafka, Airflow, or equivalent cloud-native services.

- Experience with Ontologies and Semantic systems

The team includes experts in power systems, databases, software engineering, and optimization, working together to address complex challenges in a mission-critical environment.
In this role, you will serve as a technical lead and trusted partner to customers, helping define requirements, establish high-level system designs, and support successful delivery. You will also contribute directly to software implementation, troubleshooting, customization, and integration across GE and customer environments.
This position offers the opportunity to work on a sophisticated platform that supports high-security, high-availability operations and leverages modern software technologies. It is well suited for a professional who values technical rigor, collaboration, and continuous learning in a dynamic environment.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities

- Design and architect modules and feature areas for Wholesale Electricity Market Management (MMS) applications.

- Lead technical design discussions, whiteboarding sessions, and design reviews.

- Collaborate with engineering, project, and customer teams to deliver solutions effectively.

- Define scope, estimate effort, and work with the Project Manager to establish timelines.

- Evaluate technology options and make informed decisions based on analysis, risk, and technical fit.

- Mentor team members and support complex customer implementations.

- Document technical solutions, troubleshoot issues, and support resolution of defects and production concerns.

title: Senior AI Architect
description:
Job Description Summary
The Senior AI Architect, MLOps / DevOps / Cloud Engineering is an enterprise technical authority responsible for defining how AI solutions are productionized, deployed, operated, monitored, secured, and continuously improved across Wind Engineering.

Building on the broader Senior AI Architect mandate, this role provides specialized leadership in MLOps, DevOps, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, distributed AI systems, CI/CD, observability, model lifecycle management, and production reliability. The role establishes the architectures, engineering practices, reusable components, and operational standards required to move AI models and workflows from experimentation into reliable, maintainable, and scalable engineering products.

This person partners closely with Digital/IT, ARC Foundry, enterprise platform teams, AI engineers, data engineers, and Embedded AI Architects to ensure solutions use approved infrastructure and integration patterns, are designed for sustainable operation, and can transition into GE Vernova ownership without dependence on fragile code, undocumented environments, or external support.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
1. Define the MLOps, DevOps, and Cloud Architecture for Wind Engineering AI

- Define and maintain reference architectures for deploying and operating AI solutions across cloud, edge, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

- Define how AI workloads use enterprise environments, including approved cloud services, container platforms, model repositories, data platforms, APIs, engineering applications, and authentication services.

- Make architecture decisions across cloud, edge, and on-premises execution based on data sensitivity, latency, compute demand, cost, reliability, and engineering workflow requirements.

2. Establish Production-Grade AI Delivery Pipelines

- Design standardized CI/CD and continuous training patterns for AI-enabled engineering applications.

- Establish automated pipelines for code build, testing, model validation, security checks, packaging, deployment, and rollback.

- Define quality gates that prevent models or AI services from progressing into production unless they meet documented software, model-performance, data-quality, security, and engineering-validation criteria.

3. Own Model Lifecycle and Production Operations Standards

- Define the operating model for AI models from development and validation through deployment, monitoring, retraining, retirement, and replacement.

- Establish model-registration and versioning practices that preserve provenance, approval evidence, performance baselines, applicability limits, dependencies, and release history.

4. Build AI Observability, Reliability, and Drift-Management Practices

- Define observability standards for AI applications, model services, pipelines, APIs, workflows, and supporting infrastructure.

- Define performance baselines, service-level expectations, alert thresholds, and escalation paths for production AI solutions.

- Establish diagnostic practices that distinguish model issues from data, application, infrastructure, integration, or workflow failures.

- Define incident-response, rollback, recovery, and post-incident learning practices for production AI systems.

5. Embed Security, Governance, and Auditability by Design

- Integrate cybersecurity, identity, access control, secrets management, network, data-protection, and audit requirements into AI platform and deployment architectures.

- Partner with AI Governance, cybersecurity, Digital/IT, and platform teams to translate policies into enforceable technical controls.

6. Lead Technical Transfer and Sustainable GE Vernova Ownership

- Assess whether AI applications are technically ready to transition from external partners, research teams, or pilot environments into sustained GE Vernova operation.

- Require maintainable code, automated deployment, operating documentation, monitoring, test coverage, version history, and clearly assigned support ownership before transfer.

- Ensure reusable components and lessons learned are incorporated into enterprise standards and reference architectures.

7. Provide Portfolio Architecture Review and Technical Escalation

- Review subsystem AI designs for deployability, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, observability, cost, and supportability.

- Identify production risks early, particularly where research prototypes, local infrastructure, manual processes, or undocumented dependencies could prevent scale.

8. Mentor Architects and Raise Production Engineering Capability

- Mentor AI Architects and AI engineering teams in cloud architecture, DevOps, MLOps, observability, testing, security, and production-readiness practices.

- Define competency expectations and practical development pathways for engineers responsible for building and maintaining production AI solutions.

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree strongly preferred.

- Significant hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying AI or machine learning solutions in complex technical environments, with demonstrated progression to enterprise-level architecture responsibilities.

- Experience defining technical standards, reference architectures, and design practices across a portfolio of AI solutions.

- Familiarity with AI/ML systems in production (e.g., Kubernetes, MLflow or similar registries, Terraform, Airflow/Kubeflow, Prometheus/Grafana) and enterprise data platforms.

Desired Characteristics:

- Ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders, Digital/IT teams, platform owners, and governance stakeholders.

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translate architecture standards into practical guidance.

- Experience with ARC Foundry, AMP, or GE Vernova enterprise AI platforms and integration patterns.

- Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., n8n, LangGraph, CrewAI) and experience designing multi-agent workflow architectures for engineering applications.

- Experience mentoring and developing AI engineering talent across distributed teams or matrixed organizations.

- Comfortable with Lean and engineering standard work concepts, with the ability to apply AI architecture thinking to process improvement and waste elimination.

- Strong ownership mindset, equally comfortable driving technical strategy at the enterprise level and reviewing detailed subsystem-level design decisions.

- Technical escalations are resolved promptly, with documented architecture decisions and rationale available for future reference.
