title: Sr Software Architect - AI/ML
description:
Job Description Summary
GE Vernova’s Grid Software team is at the forefront of the energy transition, delivering the software solutions that power the world’s most critical power grids. We are seeking a Senior Software Architect and AI Services Expert to lead our technological evolution.
This is not a traditional architecture role. We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who will bridge the gap between high-level architectural strategy and the next generation of AI-assisted software delivery. You will define our AI-enabled Services methodology, ensuring that our teams move beyond ad-hoc experimentation to a disciplined, production-ready, and scalable development workflow. You will be instrumental in driving productivity, optimizing delivery cycles, and generating measurable value for our utility customers.

Job Description
Core Mission
You will serve as the solution owner for all AI-assisted Services implementations within the Grid Software portfolio. Your goal is to instill a culture of "AI-assisted discipline"—where AI is a force multiplier for high-quality, secure, and maintainable code, rather than a shortcut for speed at the expense of integrity. You will be required to provide hands on guidance and accelerate the AI adoption into various activities of Grid SW services across the global teams as at any point in time there will be multiple projects running in parallel which will require your intervention

Key responsibilities

Define and Maintain Enterprise AI Architectures and Reusable Solution Patterns

- Design, publish, and maintain enterprise AI reference architectures that provide Grid Software with proven, scalable patterns for common AI solution types (e.g., agentic workflows, RAG-based knowledge systems, time-series forecasting, computer vision).

- Develop and maintain a library of reusable AI solution patterns, components, and design templates that Embedded AI Architects can leverage to accelerate delivery and ensure consistency.

- Establish architecture standards that address data ingestion, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management for AI solutions across Grid Software Services.

- Ensure reference architectures are aligned with GE Vernova enterprise platforms, ARC Foundry capabilities, Digital/IT infrastructure, and approved tooling.

- Regularly review and update architectures as AI technology, enterprise platforms, and Grid Software Services use cases evolve.

2 . Create and Maintain AI Design Practices

- Define Grid Software Services’ AI solution design practices, including design review processes, architecture decision records, and technical documentation standards.

- Establish standards for how AI solutions are scoped, designed, validated, deployed, and maintained across the Grid Software Services portfolio.

- Develop design principles that prioritize scalability, reusability and Services workflow integration from the earliest stages of solution design.

- Create and maintain AI architecture review checkpoints within the portfolio stage-gate process, ensuring technical quality is evaluated at key maturity transitions.

3. Update Services Standard Work and Quality Management Systems with AI Advancements

- Identify opportunities to embed AI-forward practices into existing Services standard work, design processes, and quality management system (QMS) documentation.

- Lead the integration of AI-assisted workflows into Grid Software Services standard processes, including AI-assisted updates, design review workflows, and validation procedures.

- Ensure that AI tools and capabilities introduced into Services workflows are supported by updated standard work documentation, training materials, and process guidance.

- Work with Services leaders and quality teams to define how AI-generated outputs are reviewed, validated, and incorporated into Services records and decision-making.

- Establish the technical baseline for how AI contributes to Services quality.

4. Partner with Digital and IT on Platforms, MLOps, and Integration Standards

- Serve as the primary technical liaison between Grid Software Services AI programs and Digital/IT, ARC Foundry, and enterprise platform teams.

- Define MLOps and LLMOps requirements for Grid Software Services, including model training pipelines, deployment automation, performance monitoring, drift detection, and retraining governance.

- Evaluate platform options, integration approaches, and tooling choices that enable scalable, maintainable AI deployment across Grid Software Services Services environments.

- Ensure AI solutions built on enterprise platforms (AMP, AWS, Azure, GE Vernova digital infrastructure) leverage approved integration patterns and do not create technical debt or unsupported dependencies.

- Define and maintain Grid Software Services's AI toolchain standards, covering development environments, model repositories, data pipelines, orchestration frameworks, and deployment targets.

5 . Review and Guide AI Designs for Scalability and Reuse

- Conduct architecture reviews for AI solutions being developed within subsystems and functions, evaluating alignment to enterprise standards, scalability, security, maintainability, and reuse potential.

- Identify opportunities where solutions designed for one subsystem could be abstracted and reused across multiple Grid Software Services domains, and drive that reuse proactively.

- Provide technical guidance to project  AI solution teams at critical design, integration, and deployment decision points.

- Maintain visibility of the full Grid Software Services AI solution portfolio from a technical architecture perspective, identifying patterns, gaps, redundancies, and cross-subsystem dependencies.

- Ensure solutions are not built in architectural isolation, and that local technical decisions do not foreclose enterprise-scale reuse or create integration complexity.

6. Mentor and Develop AI Architects

- Provide consistent technical mentorship, coaching, and development support to the AI Architect community across Grid Software Services.

- Define technical competency expectations for AI practitioners and create structured development pathways aligned to those expectations.

- Facilitate regular technical forums, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions across the AI practitioner community to accelerate cross-pollination of ideas and proven approaches.

- Support AI practitioners in navigating complex technical decisions, vendor evaluations, and architecture tradeoffs within their subsystems.

- Ensure AI practitioners have access to the reference materials, tools, standards, and mentorship needed to deliver high-quality AI solutions within their domain.

7. Serve as Owner for Complex AI Initiatives

- Act as the senior technical authority for AI solutions that are high-risk, architecturally novel, cross-subsystem in scope, or under consideration for enterprise-scale deployment.

- Provide technical input to governance reviews, build vs. buy vs. ARC Foundry decisions, and vendor evaluations for AI platforms and tools.

- Support the AI Governance Leader in assessing the technical dimensions of model risk, data integrity, cybersecurity posture, and auditability for AI solutions under governance review.

- Evaluate the technical feasibility, scalability, and sustainability of proposed AI approaches at early stages to prevent costly architectural missteps.

- Maintain technical leadership credibility through direct engagement with complex AI Services problems across Grid Software Services.

Required Qualifications:

- 15+ years of strong hands Software development experience, technical architecture, and working with large scale enterprise systems.

- Bachelor’s degree in services, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree strongly preferred.

- Proven expertise in machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.) and generative AI technologies (LLMs, SLMs, diffusion models, GANs).

- Significant hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying AI or machine learning solutions in complex technical environments, with demonstrated progression to enterprise-level architecture responsibilities.

- Deep technical knowledge across AI/ML domains relevant to industrial Services, including supervised learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, generative AI, agentic workflows, and physics-informed modeling.

- Experience defining technical standards, reference architectures, and design practices across a portfolio of AI solutions.

- Familiarity with MLOps platforms, cloud AI infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), model serving frameworks, and enterprise data platforms.

- Strong ability to focus on business outcomes by AI augmentation into existing processe and Strong trouble shooting skills

Desired Characteristics:

- Ability to partner effectively with Services leaders, Digital/IT teams, platform owners, and governance stakeholders.

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translate architecture standards into practical guidance.

- Practical experience with AI in Services contexts, including design automation, simulation acceleration, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, or AI-assisted validation workflows.

- Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., n8n, LangGraph, CrewAI) and experience designing multi-agent workflow architectures for Services applications.

- Experience mentoring and developing AI Services talent across distributed teams or matrixed organizations.

- Comfortable with Lean and Services standard work concepts, with the ability to apply AI architecture thinking to process improvement and waste elimination.

- Strong ownership mindset, equally comfortable driving technical strategy at the enterprise level and reviewing detailed subsystem-level design decisions.

- Technical escalations are resolved promptly, with documented architecture decisions and rationale available for future reference.

- Good communication skills and prior experience of working with globally distributed teams

Why Join GE Vernova?
At GE Vernova, your work has real-world consequences. You will be building tools that help utilities balance the grid, integrate renewable energy, and ensure power reliability for millions. This role offers the rare opportunity to redefine how an entire industrial Services organization delivers software, setting the global standard for AI-assisted energy innovation.

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Governance & Responsible AI Leader
description:
Job Description Summary
The Governance & Responsible AI Leader is accountable for defining and enforcing the standards that govern safe, compliant, and responsible use of AI across Wind Engineering. This role manages technical and non-technical risk, including cybersecurity, intellectual property protection, regulatory compliance, and Responsible AI practices. The AI Governance Leader ensures that AI systems can be trusted, audited, and sustained over time, and operates independently from solution delivery to provide objective, credible oversight.

Reporting to the Director – AI Strategy & Transformation, the ideal candidate is a risk-oriented leader with a strong background in technology governance, compliance, or legal/regulatory frameworks who understands both the promise and the peril of AI deployment in a complex industrial engineering environment.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

1. Define and Maintain the Wind Engineering AI Governance Framework

- Design, publish, and maintain a comprehensive AI governance framework covering risk management, compliance, cybersecurity, data standards, intellectual property, and Responsible AI.

- Establish clear decision rights, approval authorities, and escalation paths for AI deployments across Wind Engineering.

- Translate enterprise and regulatory requirements into practical governance standards that engineering teams can understand and apply.

- Ensure the governance framework evolves in pace with new AI capabilities, technologies, regulatory developments, and lessons learned from deployed solutions.

- Maintain a Wind Engineering AI governance register that tracks active policies, standards, waivers, and compliance status across the portfolio.

2. Establish and Enforce Responsible AI Policies

- Define Wind Engineering's Responsible AI principles, covering safety, transparency, accountability, explainability, and human oversight.

- Establish policies for how AI systems should behave in high-consequence or safety-critical engineering decisions, including clear human-in-the-loop requirements.

- Develop standards for data provenance, bias evaluation, and performance monitoring.

- Ensure that AI usage policies reflect current regulatory expectations and GE Vernova enterprise standards.

- Proactively monitor the external AI regulatory landscape and assess impact on Wind Engineering AI programs.

3. Oversee Risk Management, Validation, and Auditability

- Define risk tiers and corresponding validation requirements for AI solutions deployed across Wind Engineering.

- Establish requirements for documentation, performance monitoring, drift detection, and lifecycle management across deployed AI solutions.

- Ensure AI models used in engineering decisions are auditable, reproducible, and supported by appropriate documentation for quality management system (QMS) integration.

- Partner with Senior AI Architects to ensure that technical solutions are designed with auditability, traceability, and maintainability as first-order requirements.

4. Govern Cybersecurity, IP Protection, and Data Privacy for AI

- Partner with Product Security to define cybersecurity standards specific to AI systems, including model security, API access controls, adversarial attack awareness, and supply chain risk.

- Establish IP protection guidelines covering the use of third-party AI tools, vendor-hosted models, open-source AI components, and data shared with external AI platforms.

- Partner with Legal and IP Council teams to ensure AI data practices meet applicable privacy requirements, including data minimization, access controls, and residency standards.

- Evaluate new AI tools and vendors through a security and IP lens before introduction into Wind Engineering workflows.

- Develop guidance for the safe use of generative AI tools, including GitHub Copilot, large language models, and AI-assisted design tools, in engineering contexts involving proprietary data.

- Operate as the governance checkpoint in the AI portfolio stage-gate process, providing structured review and approval at key maturity transitions (POC to MVP, MVP to PPS).

- Evaluate AI initiatives for risk profile, compliance readiness, data governance posture, security, and Responsible AI alignment before production deployment.

- Issue governance approvals, conditional approvals, or escalations based on risk level and policy alignment.

- Maintain a clear record of governance decisions, conditions, and exceptions to enable audit readiness and accountability.

- Ensure that AI deployments do not proceed to production scale without satisfying defined governance criteria.

6. Partner with Legal, Security, Privacy, and Compliance Teams

- Serve as the primary point of contact between Wind Engineering AI programs and enterprise Legal, Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Regulatory teams.

- Translate enterprise AI policies into Wind Engineering-specific requirements and ensure they are embedded into AI initiatives and Engineering design processes.

- Ensure that AI-related contractual obligations, vendor agreements, and data sharing arrangements are reviewed for governance risk.

Required Qualifications

title: Lead Scientist - Artificial Intelligence
description:
Job Description Summary
As a global leader in the energy domain, GE Vernova is a purpose-built energy technology company on a mission to electrify and decarbonize the world. Our Artificial Intelligence (AI) team at GE Vernova’s Advanced Research Center is at the heart of this mission, developing and demonstrating innovative AI technologies to transform the future of energy. You can be a part of a highly skilled, dynamic and motivated team of AI Researchers, who are laying the groundwork for GE Vernova to succeed in its mission.

As a Lead Scientist, you will lead and/or execute on projects to design, develop, and apply innovative AI technologies, including machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, and foundation models, to tackle complex challenges in the energy sector. Your work will span the entire research spectrum, from fundamental theoretical and empirical investigations to prototyping and solution development. You will have the opportunity to define and work on diverse projects, including power generation, renewable energy, electric grids, robotics, and manufacturing, in collaboration with GE Vernova's business units and a broad network of Researchers across disciplines and domains. Additionally, you will contribute to cutting-edge research programs with external partners in academia and government, driving the advancement of AI research at GE Vernova and pushing the boundaries of human scientific understanding globally.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities

- Research, conceptualize, and develop AI solutions for hard industrial problems

- Lead projects and collaborate with teams of peer researchers on new and continuing projects

- Demonstrate value of AI through early prototypes and solutions for real-world problems

- Employ software libraries, tools, and practices to implement efficient, scalable, and reusable solutions

- Create intellectual property by writing invention disclosures and filing patents

- Publish research work to scientific journals and conferences

- Write and/or support grant proposals

Required Qualifications

- PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or related fields and a minimum of 2 years of work experience with a focus on Artificial Intelligence
OR
MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or related fields with a minimum of 5 years of work experience with a focus on Artificial Intelligence

- Demonstrated ability to write Python code

- Familiarity with GenAI packages including models from OpenAI, Google, Meta, etc. and ML frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.

- Experience in one or more of the following areas: (a) Training domain-specific large language models (LLM), (b) Development of time-series or multi-modal foundation models, (c) Building and leveraging knowledge graphs with LLMs for reasoning and memory, (d) Integrating physics in scientific machine learning models

Eligibility:

- Must have work authorization for the US.

- Must be willing to work out of an office located in Niskayuna, NY

Desired Characteristics

- Completed PhD focused on new advancements in Artificial Intelligence

- Demonstrated ability to lead AI projects

- Strong communication skills for engaging stakeholders, defining key problems, and sharing progress and outcomes.

- Experience writing and executing grant-supported research, including successful proposal development and communication with government agencies (e.g., DoE, ARPA-E, DoD, DARPA).

title: Senior Staff Engineer - AI Engineering
description:
Job Description Summary
GE Vernova is embracing cutting-edge technologies to streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and drive growth. As part of this vision, we are building a dedicated team to leverage Generative AI and redefine how we engage with our industry. The ultimate goal of the team is to automate prompting, develop a framework for prompting across use cases to maximize reuse as well as sharing across businesses.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating and optimizing prompts for LLMs, collaborating with domain experts and end users to develop software solutions that address both internal and external needs. This position offers a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and traditional industry, making a tangible impact on our business processes.

As a GE Vernova accelerator, AI Foundry is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.
Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into clear and effective LLM prompts.

- Develop, test, and refine prompts for a variety of use cases, ensuring high accuracy and relevance in generated outputs.

- Work closely with software developers to integrate LLM solutions into existing or new applications.

- Contribute to the development of a scalable framework for prompt engineering, promoting reuse and knowledge sharing across different business units.

- Assist in gathering and analyzing user feedback to continually improve prompt effectiveness.

- Stay up-to-date with advancements in LLM technology and contribute to strategic decisions on tool and platform selection.

- Document prompt engineering processes, best practices, and use case outcomes to build a comprehensive knowledge base.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering , Mathematics, or related field with 8+ years' relevant experience.

- Must be willing to work out of an office located in Niskayuna, NY or Cambridge, MA.

This immersive program allows our senior talent to establish a strong technical foundation, collaborate with our premier scientists and engineers, and align with our mission to lead the energy transition from the epicenter of our innovation hub. Travel, housing, and living stipend provided.

Ideal Candidate Characteristics:

- PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field

- Experience with prompt engineering and familiarity with tools such as OpenAI’s GPT models, Hugging Face, etc.

- Proficiency in Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI/ML development.

- Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and data processing libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).

- Previous experience or internships involving NLP or machine learning projects.

- Familiarity with version control systems like Git.

- Understanding of traditional industry operations and challenges.

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Manager – Labour Compliance & Governance
description:
Job Description Summary
India's labour law landscape is undergoing its most significant transformation in decades. The consolidation of over 40 central statutes into four Labour Codes is reshaping how enterprises manage workforce compliance — and GE Vernova needs a senior leader who can build the frameworks to get it right.
As the Labour Compliance Leader, you will own enterprise-wide implementation of the four Labour Codes across a complex, multi-site organization spanning corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and project sites across India. You will design the governance infrastructure, lead the audits, shape the policies, and be the authoritative voice that helps business and HR leaders navigate India's evolving statutory landscape with confidence.
This is a high-impact senior role for someone who brings deep expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.

Job Description
What You'll Do

- Lead enterprise Labour Code implementation  — own compliance readiness across all business units, establish governance controls and monitoring frameworks, drive closure of implementation gaps through structured action plans, and advance the digitization of labour compliance processes.

- Own the compliance calendar and audit function  — develop and manage the statutory filings, returns, renewals, and amendment schedule; lead labour audits; coordinate with labour inspectors, auditors, and government authorities; and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.

- Govern contractor and vendor compliance  — oversee the statutory compliance of manpower contractors and vendors across factories and project sites, conduct periodic audits, and enforce corrective actions where required.

- Support labour and employee relations  — liaise with Office Labour Governance, People Operations, Project Site Managers, and Factory Labour Relations teams; support resolution of labour disputes and inspections; and represent the organization in labour hearings, conciliation proceedings, and government inspections.

- Design and standardize compliance policy  — develop labour compliance Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, and frameworks; standardize processes across all operating environments; and serve as a subject matter expert for leadership decision-making on compliance matters.

- Enable capability across the organization  — conduct regular training for HR professionals, site leaders, factory managers, and contractors on applicable labour laws, new Labour Codes, and compliance obligations.

Who You Are
You are a seasoned labour law and compliance professional with deep knowledge of India's Central and State statutory frameworks, and hands-on experience operating across multi-site, complex industrial environments.
Required

- A formal education and subsequent Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law (LLB), Human Resources (HR), Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

- 15+ years of progressive experience in labour law compliance, industrial relations, and statutory compliance within manufacturing, infrastructure, engineering, construction, or project-based organizations.

- Proven track record implementing and managing compliance under Central and State Labour Laws, including the new Labour Codes.

- Hands-on experience managing compliance across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and project sites.

- Demonstrated experience handling labour inspections, statutory audits, government authorities, and legal proceedings.

- Solid experience in contractor and vendor compliance management.

- Strong working knowledge of the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, Factories Act, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code, Occupational Safety Health and Working Conditions (OSHWC) Code, and Wage Code.

- Familiarity with compliance management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), and standard productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office).

Preferred

- Master's degree in HR, Industrial Relations, Labour Welfare (MLW), Personnel Management, or an MBA in HR.

- Professional certifications in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, Compliance Management, or Occupational Health and Safety.

Grid Automation provides a complete range of innovative products, systems and services covering the design, manufacture, commissioning and long-term maintenance of Substation Protection and Automation solutions.

The Technical Applications Engineer (TAE) supports the Commercial team in the coordination and execution of all technical and commercial activities within the Grid Automation business.

A vacancy has arisen for a TAE role within South Europe (SEU). The successful candidate will be part of a regional Europe TAE team, with a primary focus on ITALY, while also supporting technical and commercial activities across the wider SEU region, including Spain, Portugal and other assigned countries.

This is a key technical role within Grid Automation, combining deep engineering expertise with customer interaction and commercial support.

The role plays an important part in enabling the digitalisation of substations and supporting the energy transition across Europe, with a strong strategic focus on the ITALIAN market while contributing to the broader South Europe region .

- Review, analyze and resolve customer application enquiries using sound engineering principles, ensuring compliance with business standards, procedures and delivery requirements

- Provide technical support across the full Grid Automation portfolio, including Digital Control Systems, Substation Automation, Protection systems, RTUs, network management and OT cybersecurity solutions

- Support Sales and Commercial teams in defining optimal technical solutions, product positioning, customer presentations and technical negotiations

- Contribute to and complete formal technical tenders in line with customer specifications and business requirements

- Deliver customer training on application, configuration and operation of Grid Automation solutions

- Participate in customer meetings, site visits, seminars, conferences and industry events as required

- Degree in Electrical, Electronic or Telecommunications Engineering, or Computer Science

- Proven experience in a customer-facing engineering role

- Strong and deep understanding of Power Systems fundamentals is essential

- Solid knowledge of Protection & Control principles and Substation Automation systems

- Experience with IEC 61850-based Substation Automation solutions (highly desirable)

- Understanding of RTUs, HMI systems, network protocols and OT environments

- Cybersecurity experience in OT environments (preferred)

- Ability to analyze complex technical applications and produce clear technical reports

- Commercial awareness and ability to work effectively with Sales teams and customers

- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally within the SEU region

- MANDATORY: Italian and English (business fluent)

- Highly valued: Spanish, Portuguese, or Balkan languages (Serbian, Croatian, Romanian, etc.)

Desired Characteristics:

- Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

- Ability to manage multiple technical enquiries in parallel

- Strong problem-solving mindset with structured engineering thinking

- Customer-focused, proactive and solution-oriented approach

- Ability to work effectively in a regional and cross-functional environment

title: Sustainability AI Leader
description:
Job Description Summary
The Sustainability AI Leader drives the end-to-end digitalization of all sustainability processes at Electrification, deploying artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and digital solutions to transform sustainability reporting, planning, and decision-making across the organization.
This role is responsible for coordinating with GEV HQ and Electrification DT teams to deploy the ELEC Sustainability Long-Term Strategy (LTS) for digitalization and AI. The leader will define the technology roadmap, align priorities across business lines, and ensure seamless integration of digital capabilities into sustainability workflows.
A core deliverable of this role is achieving a 30% productivity improvement and net positive impact on cost structure by removing all administrative and non-value-added tasks from sustainability reporting through automation, AI-powered tools, and intelligent process design. The role requires a unique combination of sustainability expertise, digital leadership, and AI/data science acumen.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

- Lead the end-to-end digitalization of sustainability processes across Electrification, defining and executing the digital transformation roadmap for sustainability reporting, planning, and performance management.

- Deploy and operationalize the ELEC Sustainability Long-Term Strategy (LTS) for digitalization and AI, translating strategic objectives into actionable technology initiatives with clear milestones and KPIs.

- Coordinate with GEV HQ and Electrification DT teams to ensure alignment on digital strategy, shared platforms, data standards, and AI governance across the organization.

- Develop and deliver AI-powered systems, applications, and digital tools that create measurable value for internal and external customers, including predictive analytics, automated reporting, and decision-support platforms.

- Drive the 30% productivity improvement target by identifying, designing, and implementing automation solutions that eliminate administrative and non-value-added tasks from sustainability reporting and compliance workflows.

- Design and implement scalable data architectures, pipelines, and AI/ML models that underpin sustainability analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning capabilities.

- Build and lead cross-functional partnerships with Finance, Digital, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to ensure digital sustainability solutions are integrated into enterprise systems and business processes.

- Establish governance frameworks, quality standards, and best practices for AI and digital sustainability tools, ensuring scalability, auditability, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

Qualifications:

- Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD preferred) in AI/Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

- Significant proven progressive experience in digital transformation, AI deployment, sustainability technology leadership, or related roles with demonstrated impact at enterprise scale.

- Proven track record of developing and deploying AI/ML solutions, digital platforms, and automation tools that deliver measurable business outcomes (productivity, cost reduction, process efficiency).

- Experience coordinating across global matrixed organizations, including HQ functions, business units, and cross-functional digital teams. Familiarity with Electrification Segment and GEV structures preferred.

- Strong understanding of sustainability metrics, sustainability reporting frameworks (EU taxonomy, CSRD, GRI, TCFD), and the ability to translate sustainability requirements into digital and AI solution specifications.

- Very good communication and stakeholder management skills in a global, matrixed environment, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership and drive adoption of digital solutions across diverse teams.

title: Staff Software Engineer - User Interface
description:
Job Description Summary
Consulting Services, a part of GE Vernova, has offices in multiple countries and offers our global clients (external & internal GE) a wide range of solutions across the entire spectrum of power generation, delivery, and utilization. Our Power Systems Engineering team utilizes their deep knowledge of connected power grid planning, design, operation, and life-cycle management, to offer customized solutions to our global clients. Our Power Economics team offers analyses focused on the understanding and the study of the financial and physical operation of the electric power systems including generation and grid planning, system optimization, asset valuation, competitive power markets and energy policy implications. Our software business plays a critical role in delivering these solutions by developing and maintaining cutting-edge analytics platforms for production cost modeling, capacity expansion, reliability assessment, market simulation and both steady-state and transient stability simulation. These tools are continuously enhanced based on feedback from consulting engagements and evolving industry needs.
The Staff Software Engineer (User Interface) will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining reusable UI components and services that power the PlanOS platform. PlanOS is GE Vernova’s next-generation energy planning platform, designed to support utilities and system operators in making data-driven, future-ready decisions for grid reliability, resource adequacy, and decarbonization strategies. This role involves working primarily on web-based UI design systems using the React Javascript Framework and backend services using Python. The developer will be responsible, in conjunction with the PlanOS UI/UX Design and Devlopment team, for the full software development lifecycle — including requirement analysis, documentation, implementation, and ongoing maintenance — with a strong focus on scalability, performance, and usability.

Job Description
Roles & Responsibilities

- Partner with key stakeholders to understand functionality needs for PlanOS.

- Work closely with UX team members to refine user workflows and visual layouts using industry-standard UX tools such as Figma .

- Develop and maintain reusable UI components using ReactJS, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS.

- Collaborate with UX designers and product owners to implement user-friendly designs based on specifications and feedback.

- Translate customer and business requirements into clean, testable, and maintainable front-end code.

- Optimize applications for performance, accessibility, and responsiveness.

- Integrate with REST APIs and collaborate with back-end developers to deliver full-stack solutions.

- Participate in an Agile scrum team, providing technical leadership and peer code reviews.

- Contribute to the improvement of UI development processes, tools, and standards.

- Support documentation, testing, and knowledge sharing across the team.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field from an accredited college or university

- 8 to 11 years software development experience, with at least three years front-end development experience.

- Demonstrated proficiency in ReactJS, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS.

- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and integrating front-end with backend services.

- Solid grasp of UX design principles and familiarity with modern UX tools such as Figma.

- Solid grasp of the Software Development Lifcycle, agile project management, and project management tools like Jira, Trello, or Azure DevOps.

Desired Characteristics

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills

- Experience building responsive applications compatible with modern browsers.

- Familiar with GitHub, NPM, and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins).

- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

- Knowledge of Mapbox, PostgreSQL, and Trello

- Exposure with Python and libraries like Altair and Plotly for data visualization, SQLAlchemy, and Pyramid.

title: Lead Test Development Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary
At GE Vernova, we don’t just manufacture high-voltage technology—we ensure it is bulletproof. We are looking for a Lead Test Development Engineer to join our team in Stafford. You will be the architect behind the test solutions that validate our modules and products, ensuring that our equipment meets the highest safety and reliability standards before it ever hits the grid.
If you are a hands-on engineer who loves the intersection of software, hardware, and high-voltage power systems, we have a challenge for you.

Job Description
Your Impact
You will be the bridge between R&D and the production line. Your designs will define how we measure excellence, your software will drive the efficiency of our manufacturing, and your troubleshooting will ensure that our global energy projects remain safe, reliable, and on schedule.

What You’ll Do

- Build the Future of Test:  Design, develop, and implement robust, end-to-end production test solutions for high-voltage applications.

- Bridge Hardware and Software:  Develop test systems that integrate sophisticated electronic circuitry with custom software (LabVIEW/embedded), ensuring they are as reliable as the products they test.

- Ensure Safety & Compliance:  Lead the charge on PUWER, WEEE, RoHS, and REACH compliance, making safety-critical testing not just a requirement, but a standard of excellence.

- Solve the Complex:  Get hands-on with fault-finding and debugging. When a production challenge arises, you will be the technical lead identifying the root cause.

- Lead the Lifecycle:  Manage your projects from the initial "Design for Test" evaluation through to planning, commissioning, and training the operators who will use your systems.

- Collaborate Globally:  Partner with internal cross-functional teams and external outsourcing partners to ensure our test solutions are world-class.

Who You Are

- A Technical Expert:  You have a degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, paired with significant experience in a high-tech manufacturing or testing environment.

- A LabVIEW & Embedded Pro:  You have the coding skills to build test automation that is efficient, scalable, and accurate.

- A "Design for Test" Advocate:  You understand that great testing begins in the design phase, and you advocate for DfM/DfT principles at every turn.

- A Natural Problem Solver:  You don’t shy away from complex circuitry or high-voltage challenges; you find clarity in the details.

- An Effective Communicator:  You can explain complex test requirements to operators, management, and suppliers with equal clarity and confidence.

Why Join Us?
This is a rare opportunity to see your designs implemented in a real-world manufacturing environment. Based in our Stafford hub, you will be working on systems that power the energy transition, supported by a global team of experts. We offer a culture that prioritizes your autonomy, professional development, and the chance to leave a lasting mark on our manufacturing excellence.

Additional Information

title: Senior Manager – Ingénierie Qualité Globale et Amélioration Continue F/H -  Portefeuille de produits Postes Blindés au Gaz (GIS)
location_raw: Aix-les-Bains; Kassel; Oberentfelden; Noventa di Piave; Villeurbanne
description:
Job Description Summary
À propos du poste
En tant que Senior Manager – Ingénierie Qualité Globale et Amélioration Continue pour le portefeuille de produits de postes blindés au gaz (GIS), vous jouez un rôle clé dans la définition, le déploiement et la pérennisation des processus d’ingénierie qualité et d’assurance qualité sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des produits.

Vous pilotez la mise en œuvre des outils fondamentaux de l’ingénierie qualité, notamment les AMDEC Produit et Process, les plans de contrôle, la MSA et le SPC. Vous définissez les standards, les règles de gouvernance et la documentation nécessaires afin d’assurer un déploiement harmonisé de ces méthodologies à travers le portefeuille GIS et les sites de fabrication concernés.

Vous garantissez également la bonne exécution de l’ensemble des livrables Qualité NPI, en conformité avec le processus et les check-lists Confluence NPI, et veillez à la conformité complète avant chaque jalon BOD (stage-gate).

En tant que référent en analyse des causes racines (RCA) et en résolution structurée de problèmes, vous accompagnez et développez les équipes transverses afin de renforcer durablement les pratiques de résolution de problèmes au sein de l’organisation.

Expert du domaine Qualité et des produits GIS, vous pilotez l’investigation et la résolution de problématiques qualité complexes, aussi bien sur les sites industriels que chez les clients. Vous veillez à la mise en œuvre d’actions correctives et préventives robustes, contribuez à l’amélioration du rendement au premier passage (FPY) et assurez l’intégration systématique des retours d’expérience issus de la performance terrain, des retours clients et des opérations de fabrication.

Vous conduisez des initiatives d’amélioration continue à fort impact, notamment à travers des démarches Kaizen Qualité, des audits structurés des procédés de fabrication, le déploiement de stratégies de Qualité intégrée (Quality Built-In) ainsi que l’accompagnement des projets de transfert d’activité / transfert de production (TOW).

Enfin, vous définissez et supervisez la collecte, l’analyse et le suivi des indicateurs de fiabilité et de disponibilité, notamment le MTBF et les taux de défaillance, afin de soutenir des démarches d’amélioration continue fondées sur les données.

Job Description

Responsabilités principales:

- Définir, déployer et pérenniser les processus d’ingénierie qualité et d’assurance qualité sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des produits GIS.

- Piloter la mise en œuvre des outils qualité clés, notamment les   AMDEC Produit et Process , les   plans de contrôle , la   MSA   et le   SPC .

- Définir les standards, la gouvernance et la documentation nécessaires à un déploiement cohérent des méthodologies qualité sur l’ensemble du portefeuille de produits et des sites industriels.

- Garantir la bonne réalisation de l’ensemble des   livrables Qualité NPI   conformément au processus   Confluence NPI , et assurer la conformité avant chaque jalon   BOD .

- Agir en tant que référent et coach en   RCA   et en résolution structurée de problèmes auprès des équipes transverses.

- Piloter les investigations qualité complexes, l’analyse des causes racines et la mise en œuvre d’actions correctives et préventives robustes, en usine comme chez les clients.

- Conduire les plans d’amélioration sur les produits GIS ne répondant pas aux objectifs de   FPY , afin d’assurer l’atteinte et la pérennisation des résultats.

- Structurer l’intégration systématique des retours d’expérience terrain, des analyses de causes racines et des actions correctives/préventives dans les mises à jour des   AMDEC Produit et Process .

- Déployer des initiatives   Kaizen Qualité   à fort impact sur les sites de production.

- Identifier et piloter des actions d’harmonisation entre lignes et groupes de produits afin d’améliorer la qualité produit et de simplifier les processus qualité.

- Mettre en œuvre des audits structurés des procédés de fabrication, y compris sur les essais de routine, afin de renforcer la maîtrise des processus et la robustesse produit.

- Définir et déployer les stratégies de   Qualité intégrée (Quality Built-In) , en mettant l’accent sur la prévention, la détection et la réduction des défaillances critiques.

- Assurer le leadership qualité dans les projets de   transfert d’activité / transfert de production (TOW)   afin de sécuriser la montée en cadence et la stabilité de la production série.

- Définir, structurer et superviser le suivi des indicateurs de   fiabilité   et de   disponibilité , notamment le   MTBF   et les   taux de défaillance .

Profil recherché:

Formation et expérience:

- Diplôme de niveau   Licence / Bachelor   en   génie mécanique   ou en   génie électrique .

- Minimum de  8 ans d’expérience   dans le domaine des   postes blindés au gaz (GIS)   ou dans un environnement industriel étroitement lié.

Compétences techniques:

- Connaissance approfondie des produits   GIS   et de leurs exigences techniques, industrielles et de fiabilité.

- Expertise reconnue dans le diagnostic des   défaillances mécaniques , des   défauts d’isolement   et des problématiques liées à l’application des produits.

- Expérience confirmée dans la conduite d’investigations terrain et le pilotage d’actions correctives efficaces et durables.

- Maîtrise de l’interprétation et de la classification des motifs de   décharges partielles (PD) , ainsi que de l’identification des causes racines associées sur les produits GIS.

- Capacité à accompagner les équipes qualité usine dans l’analyse des PD, le diagnostic des défaillances et la mise en œuvre d’actions correctives adaptées.

- Solide expertise en   ingénierie qualité , en   gestion des risques   et en   résolution de problèmes qualité .

- Maîtrise des outils qualité fondamentaux, notamment les   AMDEC Produit et Process , l’ analyse des systèmes de mesure (MSA) , les   plans de contrôle   et les approches de maîtrise des procédés.

- Capacité à identifier les caractéristiques   critiques pour la qualité (CTQ)   et à mettre en place des dispositifs de prévention et de détection efficaces.

- Maîtrise du   SPC , de l’analyse de capabilité et des approches de pilotage fondées sur les données.

- Expérience significative dans la mise en œuvre de méthodologies structurées de résolution de problèmes telles que   8D ,   A3 ,   Why-Why ,   Fault Tree Analysis   et   RCA .

- Certification en tant que   coach RCA   requise, avec une expérience avérée dans l’animation de démarches structurées de résolution de problèmes.

- Expérience approfondie dans la conduite d’initiatives   Kaizen Qualité   à fort impact.

- Solide expérience en   audits approfondis des procédés de fabrication   et en   audits système ISO 9001 .

Compétences comportementales:

- Leadership dynamique, proactif et orienté vers l’avenir.

- Forte capacité à conjuguer vision stratégique et excellence dans l’exécution.

- Excellentes compétences en   communication en anglais , avec la capacité d’expliquer clairement des sujets techniques et qualité complexes.

- Solides aptitudes relationnelles et capacité à collaborer efficacement de manière transverse et à tous les niveaux de l’organisation.

- Expérience démontrée dans des environnements   internationaux et multiculturels .

- Capacité à piloter plusieurs projets et priorités en parallèle tout en accompagnant et mobilisant les équipes vers l’atteinte des résultats.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Rejoindre ce poste, c’est contribuer directement à l’amélioration de la qualité, de la fiabilité et de la performance d’un portefeuille de produits stratégiques. C’est également l’opportunité de jouer un rôle moteur dans la transformation des pratiques qualité, l’harmonisation des standards et le déploiement d’une culture d’amélioration continue à l’échelle globale.
Si vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service d’un environnement industriel exigeant, innovant et international, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous.

description:

The Product Safety & Compliance Engineer works directly within the engineering development team to ensure our products meet all global safety standards, regulatory requirements, and quality certifications throughout the entire product lifecycle. title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary
The role entails advanced software development for Power Systems Applications, with a focus on delivering specific functionalities to meet corporate project and product objectives. Responsibilities include collaborating with team working with Electric Utilities or Independent System Operators (ISOs) and Transmission and Distribution System Operators to develop functional software specifications, followed by designing, coding, testing, integration, application tuning, and delivery.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities

- As a senior member of the Software Center of Excellence, exemplifying high-quality design, development, testing, and delivery practices.

- Lead the design, development, testing, integration, and tuning of advanced Power Systems Application software to fulfill project and product commitments.

- Develop and evolve software in a dynamic and agile environment using the latest technologies and infrastructure.

- Provide domain knowledge and/or technical leadership to a team of application software engineers.

- Provide budget estimates for new project tasks to project leads and managers.

- Collaborate with customers throughout the project lifecycle to ensure software quality and functionality meet standards and requirements.

- Mentor junior team members.

- Interact with Product Development Teams, Customers, Solution Providers, and cross-functional teams as needed.

- Apply SDLC principles and methodologies like Lean/Agile/XP, CI, software and product security, scalability, and testing techniques.

- Provide maintenance of power systems application functionality, including code fixes, creating tools for model conversion, documentation, and user interfaces.

- Support marketing efforts for proposals and demonstrations to potential customers.

Basic Qualification

- Ph. D. or Master’s degree in Electrical Power Systems with thesis or related work in power systems

- 8 to 11 years of experience in development or project delivery, preferably in Power Systems Analysis, C++, CIM Modeling, Energy management System, Data Analysis, Scripting, Systems Integration.

Desired Characteristics

- Continuous improvement mindset; drives change initiatives and process improvements

- Highly organized and efficient; adept at prioritizing and executing tasks.

- Experience in the power systems domain.

- Proficiency in testing and test automation.

- Strong knowledge of source control management, particularly GitHub.

- Demonstrated ability to learn new development practices, languages, and tools.

- Self-motivated; able to synthesize information from diverse sources.

- Mentors newer team members in alignment with business objectives

- Continuously measures the completion rate of personal deliverables and compares them to the scheduled commitments.

- Transparent in problem-solving approaches and options; determines fair outcomes with shared trade-offs.

- Capable of defining requirements and collaborating on solutions using technical expertise and a network of experts.

- Effective communication style for engaging with customers and cross-functional teams; utilizes product knowledge to mitigate risks and drive outcomes.

- Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills; able to produce professional and technical reports and conduct presentations.

- Innovates and integrates new processes or technologies to add significant value; advises on change cost versus benefits and learns new solutions to address complex problems

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Stage ingénieur simulation multiphysique GIS
description:
Job Description Summary
GE Vernova est une société mondiale du secteur de l’énergie s'appuyant sur plus de 130 ans d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, contribuant à la transition énergétique en continuant à électrifier le monde tout en s'efforçant de le décarboner. Sur son site situé à Villeurbanne (France), l’activité Grid Solutions conçoit, teste et fabrique des disjoncteurs haute tension destinés à ses clients nationaux et internationaux.

Job Description
Le stage s’effectuera au sein du Centre de Recherche & Développement des disjoncteurs haute-tension , dans le cadre d’un projet de développement visant à se défaire du SF 6 dans les appareillages, gaz le plus polluant au monde (1kg = 22.5t équivalent CO 2 - 1% des émissions mondiales). Le stage portera sur la modélisation d’écoulement de gaz supersoniques dans une nouvelle chambre de coupure, véritable challenge de simulation multiphysique lié à l’arc électrique (à plus de 20 000K).

Le sujet sera articulé autour de 3 axes principaux  :

• Définition des paramètres de calculs, simulations numériques
• Compréhension / analyse des résultats, présentation à l’équipe projet
• Propositions d’amélioration des performances selon contraintes design

Selon le profil, le sujet pourra aussi s’orienter sur des sujets annexes en relation avec les besoins du projet ( traitement base de données, critères de design ).

Profil recherché :

• Ecole d’ingénieur 4 / 5 ème année : Génie Mécanique – Energétique – Electrique
• Français / Anglais : parlé et écrit – Curiosité, Esprit d’innovation et d’équipe, Adaptabilité
• Connaissances : Mécanique – Mécanique des fluides – Thermodynamique – Energétique
• Compétences : Simulation numérique par éléments/volumes finis – Programmation
• Outils appréciés : AMESIM – ANSYS – COMSOL – Python – #C

Durée du stage : 6 mois à partir de septembre 2025.

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

title: STAGE - Développeur Full Stack Python
description:
Job Description Summary
Dans un contexte de digitalisation des processus de traçabilité au sein de notre usine, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire pour travailler sur la digitalisation des systèmes de contrôle qualité des produits GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear). Le projet vise à établir une cartographie complète des processus de traçabilité et à développer des outils numériques fiables pour optimiser la gestion des données.

Job Description
Missions / tâches confiées :

- Analyser et comprendre les processus de fabrication et d'essais, ainsi que les besoins en traçabilité des différentes parties prenantes (fournisseurs, usine, clients).

- Développer des outils informatiques (Python, HTML, SQL) pour automatiser la saisie des résultats d’essais, générer des rapports et stocker les données dans une architecture Datalake.

- Créer une base de critères d’essais en collaboration avec les équipes de R&D et bureau d’étude, et harmoniser les formats de données.

- Proposer des solutions pour minimiser la ressaisie, réduire les erreurs et intégrer les outils développés dans l’ERP en place.

- Tester et mettre en œuvre les outils sur les lignes de production, puis rédiger les procédures d'utilisation.

Compétences spécifiques requises :

- Préparation formation ingénieur avec une spécialisation en informatique, ou expérience équivalente.

- Maîtrise des technologies : SQL, Python, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Docker, PostgreSQL.

- Connaissances en gestion de bases de données (Microsoft Access, ERP).

- Approche pragmatique et multidisciplinaire pour répondre aux besoins du terrain.

Qualités requises :

- Capacité à travailler en équipe, esprit d'initiative, rigueur, et autonomie.

- Bonne communication et capacité d’adaptation face aux enjeux de production industrielle

Niveau d'études souhaité (en cours de préparation) :

• En cours de formation (Bac+3 à Bac+5) dans le domaine de l'informatique, des systèmes d'information, ou des technologies cloud.

Domaine / spécialité de formation:
• Informatique, Développement logiciel, Ingénierie des systèmes, DevOps.

title: Packaging Engineer - Regulatory & Compliance Manager
description:
Job Description Summary
Lead the company’s packaging compliance and regulatory strategy. Initial focus is on the European Union Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR). This position will serve as the enterprise subject matter expert for packaging regulatory compliance and will coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure all products and packaging placed in all markets meet current and future regulatory requirements. Packaging standard development and coordination throughout the corporation will be required to be consistent in our presentation of our products to the customer.

Job Description
Roles & Responsibilities:

- Global strategy deliverables will be required:
- Elimination/minimization of packaging material

- Reusable transport packaging where the logistics model supports it

- Recycled-content materials

- Design for actual end-of-life recycling

- Avoidance of difficult-to-recycle laminates, coatings and mixed-material constructions

- Standardized packaging components across GE Vernova businesses Lead GE Vernova's enterprise implementation strategy for the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).

- Monitor evolving European packaging legislation and translate regulatory requirements into actionable business processes.

- Develop and maintain the company's PPWR compliance roadmap, including milestones, resource requirements, and implementation timelines.

- Serve as the primary technical expert on packaging sustainability regulations, including recyclability, recycled content, packaging minimization, labeling, and documentation requirements.

- Coordinate cross-functional teams to identify compliance gaps and implement corrective actions.

- Partner with engineering teams to incorporate regulatory requirements into product and packaging design standards.

- Collaborate with sourcing and suppliers to ensure packaging materials and documentation satisfy regulatory requirements.

- Establish governance processes, metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting for PPWR and eventual EPR compliance.

- Assure current corporate packaging specifications, procedures, and design guidelines are aligned with global packaging-related regulations.

- Lead packaging compliance risk assessments and mitigation planning. Support internal and external audits related to packaging compliance through partnership with the Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) organization.

- Develop training materials and conduct education sessions for engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, and commercial organizations. Engage with industry associations, regulatory agencies, and external consultants to remain current on regulatory developments and emerging best practices. Provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership regarding regulatory risks, implementation priorities, and investment needs.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Supply Chain, Packaging Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- 10+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, packaging engineering, product compliance, sustainability, or a related field.

- Demonstrated experience interpreting and implementing complex international regulations.

- Strong project and program management experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.

- Experience influencing stakeholders across multiple business functions without direct authority.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment.

Desired Characteristics

- Experience with European environmental regulations, including PPWR, Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), or packaging directives.

- Knowledge of packaging design, packaging materials, recyclability standards, and sustainable packaging practices.

- Experience within manufacturing, energy, industrial equipment, or other highly regulated industries.

- Familiarity with lifecycle assessment (LCA), circular economy principles, and sustainability reporting.

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent program management experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment.

title: Strategic Account Manager – Electrification (Transmission & Distribution)
description:
Job Description Summary
Job Description Summary
The Opportunity
You have spent your career at the intersection of engineering and commercial strategy in the energy industry. You know how High Voltage (HV) systems work — not just in principle, but in practice. You understand what utility executives are under pressure to deliver, and you know how to position complex technical solutions at the level where decisions actually get made.
This role is built for someone like you.
As a Strategic Account Manager within GE Vernova's Electrification business, you will own the most strategically important customer relationships in our portfolio — from the Project engineer to the C-suite. You will build multi-year account strategies that connect GE Vernova's full Electrification capability with what our customers are trying to accomplish long-term. And you will do it with the credibility that only comes from having lived the technical side of this industry firsthand.
This is not a role for someone learning the energy business. It is a role for someone who is ready to lead at its highest level.

This account manager will focus on: Sempra and Southern California Edison

Job Description
What You'll Do
You will serve as the strategic lead for key Electrification accounts, owning the relationship, the plan, and the outcomes — while coordinating across GE Vernova's full portfolio to deliver integrated solutions no single business line could offer alone.

- Own the account, end to end  — maintain executive-level relationships from the C-suite down, lead regular business reviews, and develop a rolling 3+ year account strategy that aligns GE Vernova's priorities with the customer's long-term objectives, needs, and culture.

- Represent the full portfolio  — advocate for the breadth of GE Vernova's Electrification (ELEC) product and service offerings, not only for HV systems and equipment, but also Protection and Control, power stability solutions (STATCOM, Synchronous Condensers, Fixed and Variable Series Compensation), Battery Storage and Solar Inverters, and Energy Management software ; drive collaboration across business lines where opportunities require complex or multi-business-line solutions.

- Drive cross-business growth  — co-sell with Gas Power and Wind Power sales counterparts to improve Electrification attachment rates to new generation projects; engage with the Vernova’s Enterprise Strategic Account Executive (ESAE) counterparts to increase penetration and sharpen strategy across GE Vernova.

- Apply your technical depth  — leverage your deep knowledge of HV equipment and electrical substation systems to engage credibly at every level of the customer organization, differentiate GE Vernova's solutions, and develop counterstrategies that grow share of wallet and improve win rates.

- Map and grow the relationship  — develop and execute relationship mapping that connects GE Vernova leadership with the right counterparts in the customer organization; identify and create ongoing engagement opportunities.

- Measure what matters  — use operational data, standard work, and metrics including Net Promoter Score (NPS) to monitor relationship health, account profitability, and strategic alignment.

- Report on Account Growth — Reporting to the VP, Business Development for North America, prepare and report quarterly on account growth and progression

Who You Are
You are a senior commercial leader with an engineering foundation, deep Electrification expertise, and a long track record of winning and growing share at Investor-Owned Utilities. You bring technical authority and executive presence in equal measure — and you know how to use both.

Required:

- 10 years of experience in direct sales, commercial management, account management, or a customer- or supplier-facing role within an Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) environment, or end-user setting

- Engineering background with deep technical knowledge of High Voltage equipment and electrical substation systems

- 10 years of experience in the transmission & distribution (T&D) space

- Proven success building and maintaining C-suite customer relationships and managing complex, multi-product strategic accounts

- Proximity to a GE Vernova Electrification customer center of competence, or willingness to relocate

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 30%

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field — a formal degree is valued, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements

Preferred:

- Experience navigating a large, matrixed organization to connect company strategy with customer strategy

- Strong financial management skills, including knowledge of utility economics and the competitive landscape

- Advanced degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field

- Proximity to a major airport (within 1 hour)

- Preferred base location: San Diego/Los Angeles CA
